Isamu/Other Media Extra Chapters. Numbers. At Y-City, Child Emperor is working on a new invention, "Okame-Chan", which scans the body for muscle mass and the development of nerves, balancing it out with the target's weight to determine the strength of the target's body. After testing the new invention, a monster alert sounds. Child Emperor and other heroes try to stop Jumping Spider together, but all of them are easily blown away by the creature except Child Emperor. Jumping Spider is later defeated by Saitama, but King is given the credit. Child Emperor takes the opportunity to measure the strengths of the heroes that have just arrived. When Child Emperor tries to measure Saitama's strength, the invention cracks and calculates Saitama's strength as undefined. Child Emperor misinterprets this reading as Saitama being extremely weak. On the other hand, King's strength is also undefined. Bang refuses to get measured, Genos is not able to be measured due to his robotic parts, and Fubuki gets a low rating. One-Punch Man Holiday Special Chapter. When asked what his plans for Christmas are, Child Emperor says he got invited to a lot of parties by his classmates, but complains that he won't have time for research. Owned Items. Various members of the Surface Team are discussing the items they use for fighting monsters. They are disrupted by Flashy Flash who tells them to stop chitchatting and instead concentrate on the mission. OVAs. The Murder Case That Is Too Impossible. Child Emperor and other S-Class heroes are invited to a hot spring resort, after the Dark Matter Thieves failed invasion. After the hot spring, Sitch gathers all the heroes into a celebration of the victory against the invasion. Some heroes become drunk after drinking the sake and disgust Child Emperor. Child Emperor makes small talk with Zombieman about whether or not he is enjoying himself. The next day after the ceremony, the heroes find Zombieman murdered, stabbed in the back by Atomic Samurai's katana. Child Emperor states that one of the S-Class heroes is the culprit. As he investigates the murder, he gathers evidence and information from the heroes and tries to eliminate suspects in order to find out the truth. He interrogates all, including Saitama and finally King, but is scared off by his King Engine. When progress halts, Tatsumaki tries to restrain everyone, when Zombieman suddenly wakes up. Zombieman reveals that Atomic Samurai's katana was floating with green light surrounding it similar to Tatsumaki's when it stabbed him. Child Emperor questions Tatsumaki, but she angrily denies it. Zombieman says he simply does not care about what happened the night prior and the heroes disband and the case is dropped. Later, Child Emperor is called by Sitch to look at the surveillance camera footage of last night. It is shown that Tatsumaki did in fact stab Zombieman, while heavily drunk. Zombieman Murder Case 2. Child Emperor, Zombieman, Superalloy Darkshine, and Metal Bat are dispatched to a forlorn, snowy mountain to hunt a monster. They fail to find anything, so they check into a lodge for the night. There they meet Saitama and Genos, who also got stuck on the mountain and had to check in, and Flashy Flash, who is trying to relax on a vacation. Later, in a brief fight between Speed-o'-Sound Sonic and Genos, the power goes out, followed by a sudden explosion. The heroes grab a flashlight and head to the den, finding the room destroyed and Zombieman unconscious. Child Emperor can't locate any external heat signatures, so he deduces that the culprit must be in the lodge. After recovering, Zombieman tells them what little he knows, and Sonic enters the room to prove his innocence. The group finds that they all have good alibis, completely forgetting about Flashy Flash upstairs. They assume the monster must be responsible, but after the Hero Association tells them it is just a bear monster called Bruinado, they decide it can't be. Once Child Emperor sees Saitama sneeze again, he deduces the following: the abundance of heaters in the lodge dried out the interior, Genos and Sonic's fight kicked up flammable dust, Saitama's sneeze pushed the dust into the den, all the electricity being used caused a breaker to trip, and Zombieman's lighter caused the dust to detonate. The group is relieved at the conclusion. Suddenly, Bruinado crashes through the front door - however, he is quickly defeated by the abundance of S-Class heroes. Upstairs, Flashy Flash continues to use all the lodge's power as he relaxes. Video Games. Child Emperor is a playable character in the video game, "One Punch Man: A Hero Nobody Knows".

Isamu/Relationships Hero Association. Bofoi. Bofoi and Child Emperor are two of the only heroes whose intelligence and reliance on their own technology are their strength while not possessing any superhuman attributes or abilities (disregarding Child Emperor's above average human abilities). Child Emperor appears to be one of the few heroes that Bofoi frequently keeps in contact with, as he has displayed multiple moments of temper tantrums that Child Emperor is used to dealing with. Beyond that however, their relationship appears to be a professional one rather than an intimate one. Child Emperor and Bofoi have contrasting mindsets due to their differing personalities. Child Emperor has a caring side that makes him think of the well being of others in a given situation, while Bofoi focuses on a more cold and calculating method in order to achieve better results without excessive consequences. This creates a conflict between the two when proposing strategies in a given situation. Child Emperor seems to hold some level of respect for Bofoi. Upon hearing of him not partaking in the rescue and ambush of the Monster Association, Child Emperor was shocked and attempted to make Bofoi reconsider, though he would find some of Bofoi's methods to be more excessive than it has to be. Bofoi seems to hold Child Emperor to some level of regard, as he expected Child Emperor to analyze the situation better than he did and lectured him about his failings and potential of the Monster Association threat. He was formerly Bofoi's assistant. After the events of the Monster Association Arc Child Emperor lost his trust in Bofoi and planned to cut all connections he had with him. During the Neo Heroes Uprising Arc, Child Emperor suspects Bofoi is behind the cyber-enhancement of several mysterious beings for unknown reasons. This suspicion escalates when Boifoi states they are no longer allies anymore and refuses to disclose any secrets he has while revealing that he secretly spied on Child Emperor by putting a hidden camera in his lab. Tatsumaki. Despite his confidence in her power, Child Emperor greatly dislikes Tatsumaki's arrogant and selfish attitude and lack of strategical thinking since she thinks she can take on the entire Monster Association and the Human Monster Garou by herself to the point of berating the needs for a whole group S-class heroes as a support in the operation. While being polite from the outside, he is not above thinking of her as a brat rather than an adult. However, he seems to be very respectful to her as he offered her some orange juice in one of Yusuke Murata's art. Tatsumaki doesn't seem to like it, but she's not opposing it either. King. Child Emperor seems to idolize King as he is the "Strongest Man on Earth". He seems disappointed and down, thinking that King still sees and treats him as a child when he realized King decided to take unauthorized action and ditch his plan to infiltrate the Mysterious Beings/Monster Association and went to his designated location immediately. Child Emperor is also delighted when he notices that King has finally joined the battle against the Monster Association executive members. He has absolute faith in King as he claims that the heroes will win for sure with King now being on the battlefield. Child Emperor even comes up with a plan that makes use of King's killer move, the Ultimate Hellfire Burst Wave Motion Cannon, an attack that he believes King is capable of unleashing to annihilate powerful monsters. Zombieman. Child Emperor respects Zombieman due to his level-headed attitude and perseverance in combat. To Child Emperor, Zombieman is one of the only reasonable S-Class heroes. Their relationship grows during the Monster Association raid: when fighting Phoenix Man, Zombieman radios Child Emperor, telling him of the robots he encountered and defeated thanks to the weaknesses Child Emperor hypothesized. Zombieman continues by thanking Child Emperor on behalf of everyone and telling the child he was glad he (Child Emperor) was there. These words deeply moved Child Emperor and brought him to tears, and he replies by saying he hopes everything goes fine with Zombieman. Thanks to his words of appreciation, Child Emperor's resolve is reaffirmed, and he proclaims to Phoenix Man that he'll follow the example of a hero he wants to be, with a silhouette of Zombieman appearing, demonstrating the way Child Emperor has begun to look up to Zombieman. He considers Zombieman as the one who can replace him as a leader. Saitama. The two initially had little interactions, and only talk with each other during the Monster Association raid. When Phoenix Man talks to Child Emperor in his Phoenix Space, Saitama intervenes and attempts to protect Child Emperor. Once Phoenix Man is defeated, Saitama approaches Child Emperor and compliments the child, telling him that he's a great hero. Child Emperor is thankful for these words, but upon realizing who Saitama is, grows deeply suspicious of him. This suspicion is lessened when Saitama effortlessly defeats Gale Wind and Hellfire Flame, impressing Child Emperor when he finds out that they're both S-Class criminals, though Child Emperor still remains wary of him and decides not to tell him anything about the mission. After the fight between Saitama and Tatsumaki, Child Emperor was suspicious about what the Association had told everyone and decided to investigate and found out who Tatsumaki was battling. This way Child Emperor became aware of Saitama's strength.

Isamu/Synopsis History. Sometime prior to the original storyline, Child Emperor worked as Metal Knight's assistant. He also fought and defeated all of Atomic Samurai's disciples. Plot. Hero Association Saga. Alien Conquerors Arc. Child Emperor is first seen attending the S-Class heroes meeting and was slightly upset that he couldn't meet Blast, who was absent. During the meeting, Sitch explained the prophecy Shibabawa foretold before her death, but Child Emperor didn't believe it so tried to leave. He was in return mocked by Sitch, stating that Child Emperor is nothing more than a child if he does not comprehend the danger of this matter, which angered him. After the Dark Matter Thieves attack A-City, Child Emperor suggests that the Hero Association should confirm who the enemies are and whether they are what the prophecy was referring to. He later goes to the roof of the Hero Association Headquarters with Genos, Superalloy Darkshine, Tatsumaki, and King. He immediately starts thinking about ways to take care of the spaceship, while Bang, Metal Bat, Atomic Samurai, and Puri-Puri Prisoner take care of Melzargard. While using his laptop, Child Emperor warns the Hero Association staff about the about rising energy levels in the ship. Afterwards, Child Emperor appears beside Genos and Drive Knight, with the latter informing his leave. Human Monster Saga. Super Fight Arc. Child Emperor uses Underdog Man No. 22 to analyze Eyesight's poisons to find a cure for the paralysis. Child Emperor then proceeds to detonate Underdog Man No. 22, but that did not successfully kill Eyesight as she hardened her skin. Eyesight then manages to find Child Emperor, but is interrupted and eaten by Pig God. Pig God decides to go after the other monsters in Y-City afterward. Monster Association Arc. Child Emperor is investigating the tunnels left by Elder Centipede to locate the Monster Association's base. Bofoi is discussing with Child Emperor and tells him that he will not join in on the operation to raid the Monster Association. He tells Child Emperor that the Monster Association is thoroughly prepared for the Hero Association and that many heroes will be sacrificed in the process. Bofoi tells him that the Hero Association denied permission for him to plant explosives in the designated hideout of the Monster Association headquarters, because saving the hostage was their highest priority. Due to this, Bofoi will not bother with the operation. Child Emperor continues tries to convince Bofoi to partake in the raid but is rejected by Bofoi, who refuses to participate due to other potential threats. Bofoi mentions how Monster King Orochi pierced through the Metal Knight drone before it could activate its self-destruction mechanism. Bofoi suggests to Child Emperor to not trust those around him and to accumulate his power as you only need yourself to fight for justice. As a result, Child Emperor tells Sekingar to take Demon Cyborg off the roster due to a suspicious history and Silver Fang due to his past relationship with Garou. The S-Class heroes, Child Emperor, Tatsumaki, Kamikaze, Pig God, Flashy Flash, Superalloy Darkshine, Zombieman, Puri-Puri Prisoner and Sekingar attend a meeting and they reassure Narinki that they will rescue his son. They each receive a transmitter that will show their location to each other. They discuss the situation until Sweet Mask bursts into the meeting. Child Emperor tries to calm him down and get him to accept a leadership role with the surface strike team but he refuses. Child Emperor soon leaves to join the rest of the heroes preparing to leave. He notices King is missing and wonders where he is but is told by Zombieman that he can hear the King Engine. King returns and they all leave to attack the Monster Association. Child Emperor arrives at the ghost town of Z-City along with the other heroes. Child Emperor notices King missing and is informed of his disappearance. Child Emperor is disappointed at King's perceived lack of trust in him and they are soon assaulted by waves of monsters from the Monster Association. Child Emperor detects over 150 monsters and is steadily rising and overseer the support heroes. While the heroes win the battle, Child Emperor thinks it's odd that they send their weaker monsters out. He reasons out that they're being watched and destroys one of Gyoro Gyoro's spy drone. After the support heroes recover, the time for the S-Class infiltration comes to a close and they take their position. Child Emperor monitors everyone's transmitters, noticing that the one moving at high speed is Flashy Flash though it has stopped moving and wonders if it malfunctioned. As Child Emperor continues to think about the situation, he is ambushed by a monster only for it to be taken out by one of his devices, Mini Octotank No. 8. He comes across the deconstructed Metal Knight unit and scans it for any data on the hostage. He finds a route directly to the hostage room and is frustrated at Bofoi's lack of cooperation. He also worries about technology being used by the monsters due to the attempted reconstruction of the Metal Knight unit. Child Emperor comes across Phoenix Man who had destroyed his drone. After Child Emperor deploys his transparent shield he shreds Phoenix Man. He heads towards Waganma's cell and ambushes the guards there with poison gas. Sludge Jellyfish confronts them only to be quickly taken out by an explosion. They escape further ahead only to find G5 who resisted Child Emperor's initial attempts at destroying the monster. Child Emperor deploys three of his Underdog Man units to combat G5. With some assistance from Child Emperor birdlime missiles, they distract the monster long enough to escape. They come across Phoenix Man's shredded body and Waganma mentions that he recognizes the costume from a comedy show called "Animal Kingdom". The character had an ability to revive itself no matter how it dies. As Child Emperor ponders on the information, Phoenix Man suddenly arises into a new, stronger form. Child Emperor confronts the monster but is forced to summon his ultimate weapon Brave Giant. After putting Waganma in a shield, Child Emperor has Brave Giant generate an energy sword and shield, but before he can fight, Phoenix Man transports both of them into his Phoenix Space. Phoenix Man explains to Child Emperor that he intends to scout him to become a costume monster, stating that of all the heroes, he has the most darkness in him. Child Emperor denies this, saying that the other heroes look way more scary than he does, but Phoenix Man replies that Child Emperor appears to be the most stressed due to his inner desire for a trustworthy companion and an organization that makes the most of him. Phoenix Man offers to create a powerful organization with Child Emperor, one that can surpass disaster level God. He begins to hypnotize Child Emperor, telling him to reincarnate as the monster Brave Giant Man, but Child Emperor breaks out of his hypnosis and returns to the real world, punching him to the ground with Brave Giant. Phoenix Man transforms into his Prominence Hawk Mode and knocks Brave Giant back with a barrage of strikes, remarking on Child Emperor's stubbornness and stating that he will change his mind once he sees the resurrected Phoenix Man's powers. He then transforms into Phoenix Fire Falcon Mode and attempts to critically damage Brave Giant, but Child Emperor retaliates by using his move 20000 Fold Rope Skip Grinder, knocking Phoenix Man into a pillar. Child Emperor uses Brave Giant to chase Phoenix Man through the Monster Association base, but Phoenix Man suddenly turns around and uses his Phoenix Flares to burn Child Emperor's hands. Phoenix Man then attempts another attack, but promptly flies into another one of Child Emperor's electromagnetic shields which he attached while flying. Phoenix Man asks Child Emperor to reconsider the offer, but the latter is undeterred and drives his fist into the powerful bird monster. Suddenly, Phoenix Man transforms into Full Power 10000ºC Prominence, burning Child Emperor's hand again. Child Emperor desperately searches for a way out and finds a water source 50m below his current location. He releases Brave Giant's output limiter, breaking the floor and sending himself and Phoenix Man into freefall. As they fall, Child Emperor recalls Phoenix Man telling him his strength was needed, asking himself if he'd ever heard those words before. Child Emperor and Phoenix Man reach the underground waterfall, causing structural damage to part of the Monster Association base. Seeing that Brave Giant's time limit is running out, Child Emperor decides to end the fight quickly, but sees Saitama in the water off to his side. The two of them attempt in vain to communicate, and before Child Emperor can react, Phoenix Man transforms into Phoenix Penguin Mode, leaping away before throwing a large chunk of ice at Child Emperor in his special attack Phoenix Antarctic Iceberg Attack. Child Emperor, Phoenix Man, and Waganma land on top of the graveyard of the Subterranean People, with Saitama landing next to them. Child Emperor continues to fight Phoenix Man, but before the fight drags on, the latter transports them back to the Phoenix Space. Phoenix Man points out that the Subterraneans killed each other, stating that their unity was weak and likening it to both the Hero and Monster Association. He then mentions the behind-the-scenes crimes of the Hero Association. Child Emperor initially brushes it off as a psychological attack, but Phoenix Man states that he's just talking as a friend, and then confides in Child Emperor about his power, stating that his Birdbrain costume granted him freedom. Phoenix Man asks if Child Emperor's heroism benefited him and requests him again to join forces. Before Child Emperor can respond, their conversation is interrupted by Saitama, who somehow found a pathway into the Phoenix Space. After a brief conversation between Saitama and Phoenix Man, all of them are transported back to the real world. Child Emperor is contacted by Zombieman, who praises him for his spot-on analysis of the situation which proved instrumental in taking down enemy robots repurposed from Metal Knight's machinery. Zombieman thanks Child Emperor and offers to treat him to milkshakes after they defeat the Monster Association. Child Emperor gets slightly emotional and then updates Zombieman on his own progress, stating that he's doing fine. Phoenix Man resurrects the Subterraneans, who climb over Brave Giant, immobilizing it. He throws a monster cell through a crack in Brave Giant's machinery, stating it's medicine for the disease known as humanity. The monster cell attempts to force its way into Child Emperor's mouth, but he spits it out, stating that being a hero comes from the inside. He instructs Saitama to take Waganma and hide before unleashing Brave Giant's power by using Gigavolt Smash, which wipes out all the revived Subterraneans at the cost of self-destructing. Phoenix Man mocks Child Emperor for this move, stating that only his eye was slightly damaged, but then he begins hysterically laughing and writhing around. Child Emperor reveals that he tossed Tickle Bug #3 into Phoenix Man's suit, stating that he'll eventually suffocate from laughing too much. Phoenix Man ultimately transforms into the tiny and extremely weak Monster Chick Man before attempting to run away. After being complimented by Saitama for his heroism, Child Emperor recognizes the bald hero as Demon Cyborg's friend, wondering what he's doing this deep in the Monster Association base. Gale Wind and Hellfire Flame suddenly turn up, having been revived by Phoenix Man. They recognize Child Emperor and attack him in an attempt to lure out Flashy Flash, but Saitama quickly incapacitates and binds them. Child Emperor questions Saitama on his decision to venture into the Monster Assocation base, although he doesn't think Saitama appears evil. The two heroes and Waganma are rescued by Underdog Man, who transports them up to the surface. Right below the surface, Child Emperor attempts to open a manhole cover to free his group, but finds it sealed shut. The four of them push it together, and with Saitama's strength, they manage to launch the building above the exit into the air, unintentionally defeating Building Booper. The support team heroes incorrectly assume that Child Emperor himself launched the building into the air, and upon being questioned by Sekingar as to Saitama's identity, Child Emperor replies that Saitama is a hero he happened to save underground. Child Emperor then activates his transponder to update the S Class on Waganma's successful rescue, and gets all-clear responses from Zombieman, Sweet Mask, and Pig God. However, Atomic Samurai informs him that he's found a second child. Child Emperor resolves to go back for Tareo, declining Mizuki and Needle Star's offer to help. Waganma confesses that he lied about being the only hostage and apologizes, but the young hero reassures him before going back underground. Heading further into the Monster Association base, Child Emperor notes the lack of contact from other heroes, resolving to protect Tareo and meet up with everyone else. He suddenly sees Iaian, Okamaitachi, and Bushidrill laying unconscious. He checks on them, noting that they're still alive, but Iaian wakes up and warns him to run away. Evil Natural Water suddenly attacks, shooting a high-pressure water stream that Child Emperor dodges. He takes note of the monster's full appearance, thinking that despite it beating Atomic Samurai's three disciples, defeating it would be an easier fight than Phoenix Man was. Evil Natural Water shoots three more water jets containing Mad Doctor Fish, who attack Child Emperor's machinery. He maneuvers away from the fish, but they continue to attack, along with Evil Natural Water launching more water jets. Noting the high pressure of the water jets, Child Emperor assembles a robot out of components resembling LEGOs and uses Flash Freezing Breath to begin freezing Evil Natural Water, triumphantly stating that it couldn't regulate its own temperature. The fight is interrupted by a vengeful Sludge Jellyfish, who offers himself to Evil Natural Water, but is shocked when the monster begins to absorb it. Child Emperor notices that the sentient water body is absorbing Sludge Jellyfish's oil, which is resisting his machinery's freezing. It shoots another water jet, which hits Child Emperor's leg. He continues to fight, but eventually finds himself drowning in Evil Natural Water's main body. He is about to lose consciousness when Tatsumaki forms a psychic barrier around him and the other heroes using their transponder locations, pulling all of them up towards the surface. Once on the surface, Child Emperor reaches out to Sweet Mask, offering to let the A Class hero rest and let everyone else handle the fighting. Sweet Mask, while internally angered by this, accepts this offer. Child Emperor later is later surprised at Atomic Samurai's suggestion for everyone to team up, as well as when Tanktop Master arrives. When Bang, Bomb, and Fubuki arrive, Child Emperor expresses guilt over excluding Bang from the operation, but the old hero reassures him, stating that leaving him out was likely a good decision as it gave him the opportunity to deal with Garou as a teacher instead of a hero. Despite this, he feels guilty when he sees Bang and Bomb finishing off Orochi, blaming himself for everyone's hardship. He requests Zombieman to take over the operation in his place and is angry when Sweet Mask calls him a monster. When Homeless Emperor ambushes the heroes on the ground, Child Emperor is pushed out of the attack's path by Zombieman. He attempts to drag Zombieman away from the fight while informing everyone over his communicator that cadres had emerged from underground, but Fuhrer Ugly notices and crushes Zombieman's badly injured body under his foot. He then draws back his fist to punch Child Emperor, but Homeless Emperor interrupts, unleashing a massive energy attack in Child Emperor and Zombieman's direction. Child Emperor is saved by his Underdog Man robot, who manages to shield him with its own body and also uses a transparent film to protect him from any damage by the explosion. After barely surviving by escaping into an opening in the rubble, he tries to contact Bofoi via his phone, informing him of the current situation and urgently asking for his assistance against the Monster Association. Child Emperor, knowing that the oxygen in his space only lasts him about less than 10 minutes, holds his breath and hopes for someone to find him via his transmitter. Puri-Puri Prisoner appears and saves Child Emperor shortly after. Neo Heroes Saga. Psychic Sisters Arc. After the fight between Saitama and Tatsumaki, Child emperor was suspicious about what Association reported, so he decided to investigate and this way he found out the truth of battle and Saitama's true strength. Original Webcomic. Upon the request from Sitch, he tracks down the Monster Association's base in Z City and mentions they could be holding a child hostage. He accompanies the other S-Class heroes against the Monster Association. He plans out how to defeat the Monster Association, particularly Black Sperm with King after Tatsumaki is defeated. Child Emperor gets punched in the gut by Garou. Neo Heroes Introduction Arc. By the time the Hero Association is about to fall soon enough, Child Emperor becomes disillusioned with the Hero Association over the fact that two heroes he held in high regard, Metal Knight and Blast, did not come to aid them in the battle against Garou. This fills him up with resolve to become stronger without anyone's assistance. He later quits the Hero Association and joins the Neo Heroes. While visiting their headquarters, he comes across Metal Bat and Superalloy Darkshine, who have joined the Neo Heroes as well. Supreme Hero Arc. Child Emperor later shows up at the Neo Leader meeting. When McCoy introduces Infelsinave, Child Emperor thinks to himself that the Neo Heroes' PR moves are far superior to those of the Hero Association. When Metal Bat questions the decision to only have two security guards at the Neo Heroes HQ, Child Emperor states that it should be fine as long as there's no infighting. Neo Heroes Uprising Arc. Later on, Child Emperor leads a squad of Neo Heroes in subduing the ongoing monster invasion. After they take care of a threat, Child Emperor tells his subordinates to take a break, but they deny his offer, stating that they're not tired. In his mind, Child Emperor admires the effectiveness of the armor, but states that he saw something similar in Metal Knight's lab. He wonders if Dr. Bofoi is playing the sides of both the Hero Association and Neo Heroes, stating that if the doctor is planning to become a dictator then the two of them may have to cross paths again. During the robot army attack on the cities, Child Emperor is seen trying to hack into the robot's receiver to trace where they come from. Eventually, he discovers something shocking just as a Neo Heroes official tells him that his team is ready to be dispatched to take down the robots. He then hastily makes preparations to go to the field. While on the way, he unleashes a swarm of bird drones to neutralize a huge group of robots. He is then contacted by Jima and the members of the Cram school who offer help in the situation with devastating technology but he refuses and states that they must not interfere for their own safety. Child Emperor eventually reaches Bofoi's hideout and comments that it has been 3 years since they saw each other face to face. He then voices his suspicion of Bofoi's involvement in the attack since the identification signal of the robots matches his design but he immediately takes back his words as he doubts that Bofoi is the culprit since he knows his old mentor and boss is not that sloppy to not hide the ID signal like that. He then theorizes that someone from the Neo Heroes must have stolen the research and design data from Bofoi to create these robots since the battle suits worn by Neo Heroes members match his design but at the same time, he feels that the data leak in mass quantities is also far too suspicious as if Bofoi intentionally leaked them in the first place. He continues theorizing that this is the world of a super A.I. that he and Bofoi sealed off years ago after realizing how dangerous it is. After elaborating on his suspicions, he then points out the idea that humans can only surpass and control those A.I by becoming a computer themselves but at the cost of their humanity. He then links these ideas to the whole cybernetic programs undergone by the Neo Heroes and the agenda of The Organization before questioning Bofoi if the doctor had augmented his brain function and abandoned humanity as a result. With Bofoi giving him no clear answer, Child Emperor eats his lollipop infused with an unknown drug or nanomachine and prepares to force the answer out of Bofoi.

J-City J-City (J市 "J Shi") is a large seaside city situated on the Earth. There are at least 15 heroes living in this city. Locations. Evacuation Shelter. The Evacuation Shelter is a public shelter located in J-City, built by the Hero Association for use in the event of an attack by high-level Mysterious Beings. It was used when the Deep Sea King attacked, although it was broken open. Externally, it consists of a giant dome with circular windows lined around the top. Smelly Lid Prison. Smelly Lid Prison is a high-security prison that holds some of the world's most dangerous criminals. It is located on a small island just off the coast of J-City. The S-Class Hero, Puri-Puri Prisoner, is imprisoned in this facility and regularly breaks out to do hero work. Junkyard. There is also a Junkyard located on the same island as the prison, which is where the monster TV Junkyard Monster was created. Inhabitants. Heroes. Number of Heroes by Class: Plot. Hero Association Saga. Sea Monster Arc. J-City is invaded by the Seafolk. The A-Class hero Stinger is able to fend most of them off until the Sea King arrives. The Sea King rampages through the city, causing chaos and defeating the heroes Lightning Max, Puri-Puri Prisoner, Bunbun Man, All Back-Man, Jet Nice Guy, Sneck, Mumen Rider, and Genos. Before finally being stopped by Saitama.

Jakumen Jakumen (ジャクメン, "Jakumen") is a Martial Artist and user of the Giga Pro Wrestling. Appearance. Jakumen is a very tall muscular man with a well defined jaw and wide nose. His hair is light and kept short. He wears a short-sleeved white shirt with a Umber singlet over it with the initials GP on it in yellow, with black socks and wristbands. Personality. Jakumen is described to be weak-minded, not wanting to trash talk because he was nervous. He is friendly with others and respectful, showing good sportsmanship by praising Sour Face after their match and viewing his fellow martial artists as friends. Plot. Human Monster Saga. Monster Raid Arc. Jakumen is participating in the Super Fight Tournament in C-City at the the C-City Super Stadium. This is the first time Jakumen has participated in the tournament. While watching the match between Max and Suiryu, he was shocked by the latters strength, and how easily he defeated his opponent. Jakumen is pitted against Sour Face in his first match with both men being visibly nervous. He was later defeated by Sour Face when he used a chokehold to tap out. He and Sour Face exchange praise after the match, with the commentators exclaiming at the sportsmanship between them. Super Fight Arc. Jakumen is later present at the closing ceremony when it is suddenly interrupted by The Three Crows and Gouketsu, who threatens to kill them unless they become monsters. After Choze transforms into a monster, Jakumen is attacked by him as a way for Choze to test his new power. It is unknown if he survived this. Abilities and Powers. Not much is known about Jakumen's strength. The only notable fact about his strength is that he was defeated by Sour Face who praised him. Fighting Style. Giga Pro Wrestling (ギガプロレス, "Giga Puroresu"): Has not been shown yet.

Jet Nice Guy Jet Nice Guy (ジェットナイスガイ, "Jetto Naisu Gai"; Viz: Jet Niceguy) is the B-Class Rank 50 professional hero for the Hero Association. Appearance. Jet Nice Guy is a cyborg. He wears sunglasses, with some type of ear covering, he is also shown to have round shoulder and knee pads and has the letter 'J' printed on the right pectoral of his shirt. He also wears boxing gloves. He later upgraded his appearance and armor, sporting longer hair and an upgraded body. This upgraded body features much sharper shoulders, a slimmer waist, and slightly larger sunglasses. He also has a chin guard and a fin type wing on his trapezius. Personality. When J-City was attacked by the Seafolk, Jet Nice Guy hid inside the evacuation shelter. However, when the Deep Sea King attacked said shelter, he was one of the first heroes who stepped up to try to defend the civilians there. Such behavior indicates that despite being frightened, he was willing to risk his life to protect the people in the shelter. He also respects his superiors, stating that he was glad to have an A-Class hero help him fight the Sea King. History. Jet Nice Guy won the lottery and he used his winnings to pay someone to turn him into a cyborg. He joined the Hero Association sometime afterwards. Plot. Hero Association Saga. Sea Monster Arc. When J-City is invaded by the Seafolk, Jet Nice Guy hides inside the evacuation shelter along with other citizens. But when the Deep Sea King attacks the shelter, he, along with All Back-Man, Bunbun Man and Sneck, tries to defend the normal civilians. However, they are all easily defeated. Human Monster Saga. Monster Association Arc. He is one of the heroes recruited to the Monster Association raid's support team. He returns, rebuilt and upgraded for the coming battle. He kills some monsters during the initial attack against the Monster Association after his upgrades. He then attacks Rhino Wrestler, but is unable to defeat him. Abilities and Powers. As a mid ranked B-Class hero, it can be assumed that Jet Nice Guy is a fairly skilled combatant, but as expected, he can't do anything against monsters of threat level Demon. Judging by his appearance and his performance against the Sea King, it can be assumed his cybernetic components are a good deal less advanced than Genos's. Physical Abilities. Enhanced Strength: As a cyborg, Jet Nice Guy possesses strength above average human capabilities. He was able to kill some monsters just by simply punching them during the initial attack against the Monster Association after he was upgraded. Fighting Style. Cybernetic Combatant: Jet Nice Guy relies on his cybernetics to fight against monsters by delivering strong attacks thanks to his enhancements as a cyborg. Hero Rating. Jet Nice Guy's rating determined by the Hero Association:

Jinzuren Jinzuren (ジンズレン, "Jinzuren") is a worker at the Hero Association and one of its staff members. Appearance. Jinzuren is a young man with hazel eyes and hair, which he keeps in a neat, gentlemanly manner by parting it in the middle with gentle flicks outward together with an undercut. He wears a standard black business suit and a green tie. His most noticeable feature is his silver round-framed glasses. Plot. Introduction Saga. House of Evolution Arc. Jinzuren is seen with his partner at the, now destroyed, House of Evolution headquarters. He comments on the damage the culprit has caused. Hero Association Saga. National Superhero Registry Arc. During the meeting they were discussing the upcoming hero exam. Later Jinzuren was seen interviewing Genos and questioning him about whether or not he was the one that destroyed the House of Evolution. After the exams were over he was with Sneck, informing him about the result of Genos and Saitama, telling him the latter might surpass him. Sea Monster Arc. While Busho was on Mumen Rider's phone conversing with the newcomer, both Jinzuren and his co-worker surmised that this exercise could be the opportunity they needed to gauge Saitama's true strength. Alien Conquerors Arc. In the anime, during the invasion of the Dark Matter Thieves, Jinzuren and his co-worker look to the devastation of A-City. While he gauges the threat to be Dragon in scale, his partner Busho opts to withhold the danger level for now in the likely even the threat is level God. Neo Heroes Saga. Ninjas Arc. Jinzuren attends a meeting on "The Supreme Hero Production Project" hosted by Sweet Mask.

Jumping Spider Jumping Spider (ハエトリノ, "Haetorino"; Viz: Spiderino) was a Mysterious Being who changed after he didn't remove a spider that went into his ear. He was killed by Saitama. Appearance. Jumping spider had an upper half of a human male, and a giant-sized arachnid lower half based on a . History. Jumping Spider was a human who didn't remove a spider that went into his ear. This act, or lack of one, caused him to turn into a monster. Appearances in Other Media. Numbers. An evacuation alert rings out warning Y-City of a Mysterious Being with a disaster level of tiger. The monster Jumping Spider is disrupting Y-City when the heroes Child Emperor, Darkness Blade, Stinger, Red Muffler and Great Philosopher come to stop him. Jumping Spider knocks away all the heroes before Jumping Spider is killed by Genos and Saitama. However, Child Emperor attributes the credit to King. Fubuki later kills off the remaining parasites from Jumping Spider's dead body. Abilities and Powers. Jumping Spider was shown to have possessed impressive physical strength and speed, even surpassing those of A-Class heroes. His physical power level was read to be 6999 by Child Emperor's Okame-Chan, through which he determined that Jumping Spider was a Demon-level threat. Physical Abilities. Enhanced Strength: Jumping Spider was able to effortlessly knock back several A-Class heroes and an S-Class hero like Child Emperor. Enhanced Speed: Jumping Spider was very fast and agile, enough to surprise Child Emperor, an S-Class hero. He was able to outspeed multiple A-Class heroes, dodging their attacks and and knocking them out within mere moments. Web Spinning: Jumping Spider was able to quickly spin webs, and he used this ability to disarm opponents. Spider Parasite: Jumping Spider was able to release many small spiders from his body. It can be assumed that these spiders will create other "Jumping Spider"-like monsters if they infect a human. This ability persists even after death.

Junior Centipede Junior Centipede (ムカデ後輩, "Mukade Kōhai"; Viz: Centikohai) was a Mysterious Being and a member of the Monster Association. He was killed by Metal Bat. Appearance. Junior Centipede is a large centipede monster with a humanoid face. The monster is colored red in the anime. Personality. His personality is left rather ambiguous but he does show respect towards Senior Centipede and those who defeat him in battle such as Metal Bat. He also seems to be a little arrogant as he believed he is the largest centipede when he used to live in a cave and developed into an unusual size. History. Junior Centipede was a centipede that grew to an abnormal size in a cave and developed a strong self-esteem. He believed that he was at the top of the pyramid until he met Senior Centipede. Since then he has grown to respect Senior Centipede. Plot. Human Monster Saga. Monster Raid Arc. After Junior Centipede emerged from the ground with Venus Mantrap at a restaurant, he grabbed a Hero Association's sponsor's child. Junior Centipede briefly mentions that he is looking for the sponsor of the Hero Association. Before he could grab the sponsor, Metal Bat grabs his coat and engages in a fight with him and his partner. Junior Centipede is seen laying on the floor severely injured. He praises Metal Bat for his strength, but still questions Metal Bat about how high Metal Bat is in the food chain. Before Metal Bat could finish Junior Centipede off, Senior Centipede erupted from the ground. Abilities and Powers. Physical Abilities. Underground Mobility: Junior Centipede has the ability to dig under the ground at high speed. Molting (脱皮, "Dappi"): Much like Elder Centipede, every time he sheds his outer shell, Junior Centipede grows bigger and stronger than he was before alongside gaining another face.

Jupiter Jupiter (, "Mokusei") is the biggest planet in the . Overview. Jupiter, like its, is a gas giant planet composed predominantly of hydrogen and helium. Plot. Human Monster Saga. Monster Association Arc. During the fight between Saitama and Garou on Io, one of Jupiter's moons, Saitama accidentally destroys Jupiter using one of his, Serious Sneeze. Later, after Saitama travels to the past and defeats Garou before this event could occur again, Jupiter is restored due to the reversal of causality.

Justice Man "Justice Man"' (ジャスティスマン, "Jasutisuman") is a popular children's cartoon in the world of "One-Punch Man". Garou and Saitama were both inspired by the show for different reasons. This show served as a starting point for Garou and his hatred toward heroes. When he was young and in school, other children bullied him while playing heroes and monsters. They always made him take the monster role and had him beaten. Episodic Stories. Devil Earl wishes to cover the world in darkness, but Justice Man comes to save the day. Justice Man defeats Devil Earl with a Justice Punch. Justice Man teams up with Mach Woman and Little Justice to murder a Crab Monster, whom was protecting the sea from humanity. Afterwards, Justice Man found the monster's hidden stash of eggs.

K-City K-City (K市, K" Shi") is a city situated on the Earth. It has several forests. There are 16 heroes living in this city. Locations. K City Nature Park. K City has a Nature Park. Inhabitants. Heroes. Number of Heroes by Class: Appearances in Other Media. Omakes. Catch & Smash. Lord Great White emerges from the city's lake, but is quickly defeated by Saitama.

Kamakyuri Kamakyuri (カマキュリー," Kamakyurī") was an artificial mutant created by Dr. Genus. He is an advanced form of praying mantis, and purported to be among the stronger specimens of the House of Evolution. He was killed by Saitama. Appearance. Kamakyuri was a tall humanoid creature with many insect-like qualities. He was encased in a segmented, thorny exoskeleton, with clawed feet and serrated, scythe-like forelegs, similar to those of a praying mantis. Mandibles protruded on each side of his mouth, and the top of his skull was transparent and reflective, revealing his brain. Plot. Introduction Saga. House of Evolution Arc. After witnessing Saitama instantly kill Mosquito Girl, Dr. Genus takes great curiosity in him as a human specimen, and sends Kamakyuri, Armored Gorilla, Beast King, Ground Dragon, Frog Man, and Slugerous to capture him for further research. While Genos and Saitama are lounging in the latter's apartment, Kamakyuri attempts an ambush by crashing down through the ceiling. He begins to introduce himself, but is killed instantly by an irritated Saitama, who demands he pays for the damage to his ceiling. Outside, Slugerous senses Kamakyuri's demise telepathically, while a surprised Frog Man notes that he was one of their stronger members. Abilities and Powers. According to Frog Man, Kamakyuri was one of the stronger members of the House of Evolution. Unfortunately, he never had the chance to display the full scale of his abilities as he was killed instantly by Saitama mid-sentence. Physical Abilities. Enhanced Strength: Kamakyuri was strong enough to easily break through walls of concrete.

Kamikaze Kamikaze (カミカゼ, "Kamikaze"), better known by his hero alias Atomic Samurai (アトミック, "Atomikku Zamurai"), is the S-Class Rank 3 professional hero of the Hero Association and is recognized as one of its most powerful heroes. He is a swordmaster and a member of the Council of Swordmasters. Appearance. Atomic Samurai has long black hair tied in a ponytail. He has dark eyes and a defined jawline. He sports a small goatee and is usually seen chewing on a thin splinter of wood. His attire consists of a hooded red cloak with an atom symbol on the back draped over his open blue haori. Beneath the haori is a traditional loose-fitting white robe tied with a white sash and two haori himos. He wears his swords on his left side. Personality. Atomic Samurai has a rather arrogant, condescending and jocular personality, as seen when he refused to shake Saitama's hand, telling him that he only acknowledges the strong, and telling Saitama that he would greet him properly only if he makes it to the higher ranks of S-Class. He also appears to be quite sensitive about being called middle-aged. Atomic Samurai looks out for his disciples and pushes them to do their best, as seen when his disciple, Iaian, lost his arm, he refused to let his swordsmanship end. However, what he hates the most is being disregarded as a weakling, as he almost loses his composure when Sweet Mask declared Atomic Samurai weaker than him. At the same time, he only seems to tolerate people calling his disciples weak, but with great discomfort. Despite his arrogant nature, he behaves humbly to those he respects. This is seen with Bang, a fellow hero whom he holds the utmost respect for, and also his fellow Master Swordsmen. Atomic Samurai also enjoys his swordplay and makes a game out of it, often taunting monsters and showing off as he cuts them to pieces. Specifically, in the raid on the Monster Association, he ignores Rhino Wrestler after cutting him and subsequently killing a monster with the blade of grass in his mouth. Atomic Samurai also is straightforward to a humorous degree in many ways, and is incredibly confident and cocky. Atomic Samurai's advice is always to "do it more" instead of "how to do it". This aspect of his personality is most prominently seen when giving advice or improving himself, telling Iaian who had just lost his arm to simply stop bleeding in the fight against the Dark Matter Thieves, explaining to his disciples that to beat people stronger than themselves they simply need to get stronger and faster. He tends to overestimate himself. Atomic Samurai taunts and cuts Black Sperm shortly after losing to him and being saved by Tatsumaki, showing an uncalled level of confidence in himself despite having help. His arrogance has proved to have been his greatest downfall on a few occasions. One primary example was in his encounter with Black Sperm, a Dragon-level threat with the ability to multiply. Confident he could defeat the monster, he slashed the copies in half multiple times, even though they were replicating into thousands, which ultimately led to his own defeat. He was also very reckless and brazen while fighting Melzargard, refusing to find another way to kill him besides melee combat and brute force. He is also eager to test his strength against strong opponents. As a result, he thought to challenge another hero to battle and test their spirit. He chose King, who was known as "the strongest man on earth". The challenge was proposed out of curiosity about King's fighting style as well since it was largely unknown to him. He remains calm even against the most persistent of enemies. He has a way of judging a person by having them cut an apple. This was how he chose his three disciples. He later used this method of judgment on King and mistook King's inability to draw his sword (and therefore inability to cut the apple) as him cutting the apple so fast and perfectly that it went back to its original state. Rather than simply discourage or impress Atomic Samurai, the events motivate him to restart his training, showing an underlying passion for his craft, and a respect for those stronger than him. Abilities and Powers. Atomic Samurai is one of the top S-Class heroes, and is regarded as one of the most powerful. He is also considered Earth's strongest swordsman. According to Superalloy Darkshine, if Garou, in his half-monster state and before starting to break his limiter during his fight with Darkshine, were to fight Atomic Samurai, the Hero Hunter would most likely die before being able to show any of his techniques. He has the ability to perceive a person's life by asking them to cut an apple, which is the method he used to recruit his three disciples. Physical Abilities. Immense Speed and Reflexes: Atomic Samurai possesses incredible levels of speed and reflexes, being able to cut his opponents to pieces in the blink of an eye without them even managing to react. He was capable of countering many of Melzargard's attacks, which were extremely quick in their own right. His amazing speed was shown again when he defeated a transformed Haragiri, who claimed to be faster than the speed of sound whilst a human. Even though the proximity between his neck and Haragiri's blade was virtually zero, Atomic Samurai still managed to evade the blow, draw his own sword, and then slash him numerous times so quickly that Haragiri appeared to have not moved at all shortly before dying. His sword drawing speed is so fast that even Sonic could not see its execution. He was capable of slicing Rhino Wrestler, a Demon-level monster, so fast that it appeared like he did not even draw his sword out of his scabbard which the rhino-like creature assumed he had not attacked at all and was still talking for a few seconds before turning into smithereens. Additionally, Atomic Samurai has further showcased his tremendous speed in his fight against Black Sperm, a Dragon-level threat, where he was able to slash a large number of clones of the monster into dozens of pieces, in extremely rapid succession. Immense Strength: Atomic Samurai appears to have an extreme deal of strength, as he is able to easily cut through solid matter with his sword, as well as create a powerful shock wave with a single slash. His strength is said to be "nuclear-powered." Additionally, he was able to slice a monster into several pieces using only his toothpick. During his fight with G5, he was strong enough to cut apart the tough machine but not its extremely durable core, which he did not anticipate. Enhanced Durability: Atomic Samurai is quite resilient. He was able to survive an onslaught from Black Sperm, a Dragon-level Mysterious Being. Even after being put in a weakened state, he was still strong enough to destroy the roof of the hallway and bring it down on the Black Sperm copies. Enhanced Stamina: Atomic Samurai has high stamina and endurance, as demonstrated during his battle against Black Sperm, a powerful Dragon-level Mysterious Being. Despite being severely beaten down by the monster, he managed to remain conscious long enough until Tatsumaki interrupted the battle and shielded him with a psychic barrier. Later, after resurfacing with the other heroes, Atomic Samurai was able to continue to fight the remaining high-ranked monsters of the Monster Association, even though he had just been beaten down by Black Sperm earlier. Fighting Style. Master Swordsman: Atomic Samurai is an extremely formidable swordsman, so much so that he is considered to be the Earth's strongest swordsman. Legend even says that he can cut down over 100 enemies with each strike. His sword attacks are so fast and strong that the enemies are slashed into many pieces in an instant without even being able to react. He was also able to cut a monster to bits using a mere toothpick. Additionally, Atomic Samurai was able to partially cut off Black Sperm's body without causing the monster to duplicate using the blunted edge of his sword, while also pummeling him to death. However, his swordsmanship does have a limit, since he cannot slice through the gap between cells, and he can only prevent his sword from cutting blood vessels or organs, not atoms. Miscellaneous Abilities. Skilled Teacher: Atomic Samurai is shown to be very skilled at instructing and raising disciples in the art of the sword. This is demonstrated by his three disciples, who are all at the top of the A-Class rank of the Hero Association, right underneath Sweet Mask himself. According to Fubuki, all of Atomic Samurai's disciples would have already been in S-Class, if it weren't for Sweet Mask's gate-keeping. Equipment. Swords: Atomic Samurai carries two swords: a katana and a wakizashi. Stick: Atomic can use the stick he normally chews on as a weapon. Hero Rating. Kamikaze/Other Media Omakes. Numbers. Atomic Samurai makes a cameo appearance when talking about him and his students. OVAs. The Murder Case that Is Too Impossible. Atomic Samurai, his student Iaian and other S-Class heroes are invited to a hot spring resort, after the Dark Matter Thieves failed invasion. While enjoying himself at the hot spring, he voices his displeasure that some of the heroes that did not participate in the battle were also invited to the resort, but Bang manages to calm down the situation. The next day after the ceremony, the heroes find Zombieman murdered, stabbed in the back by Atomic Samurai's katana. Child Emperor sees him as the primary suspect, but Atomic Samurai has many alibis, including Tanktop Master and Sitch, so all suspicions are dropped. When the investigation's progress halts, Tatsumaki tries to restrain everyone, until Zombieman suddenly wakes up. Zombieman later reveals that Atomic Samurai's katana was floating with green light surrounding it similar to Tatsumaki's when it stabbed him. Once everything is cleared up, the heroes disband. Going Fishing with Middle-aged Men. Atomic Samurai goes fishing on a lake with Bang. The two discuss the hero business in their boat as they wait for fish. Mumen Rider and Chain'n'toad soon appear, having chased a monster all the way to the lake. They fight the monster, Giant Salamander, while Bang and Kamikaze continue their conversation through the chaos. Eventually they decide to intervene. Atomic Samurai kills Giant Salamander and rescues Chain'n'toad while Bang pulls Mumen Rider out of the water with his fishing rod. Bang then considers telling Kamikaze about Saitama's true strength, but decides to let him find out himself. Audio Books. Sonic, Becoming Saitama. Kamikaze is summoned to the Hero Association for a mission when he runs across Speed-o'-Sound Sonic disguised as Saitama. Kamikaze questions why Sonic is there and is annoyed at Sonic's attitude. Sonic draws his blade but Kamikaze blocked it with his sword with such speed that Sonic didn't even see the blade being drawn. Tatsumaki berates Sonic and Kamikaze suggests Sonic leave which he does with his smokescreen shuriken. Kamikaze and Tatsumaki stumbles upon the corpse of Energiser with Saitama nearby. Kamikaze asks what happened and why Saitama is there but Saitama responds with asking who Kamikaze is. Incensed, Kamikaze points out that it is the second time they met today and asks if he killed the monster as it was a powerful mysterious being. Video Games. Atomic Samurai is a playable character in the video game, "One Punch Man: A Hero Nobody Knows".

Kamikaze/Relationships Hero Association. Bang. Out of every hero in the Hero Association, Atomic Samurai only acknowledges and holds a deep respect for Bang. He once stated to Saitama that he only acknowledges the strong, which could be a reason for Atomic Samurai's respect for Bang, who is ranked one rank higher than Atomic Samurai. His relationship with Bang is friendly, with a tad bit of rivalry between them, though this mild rivalry appears to be one-sided (Bang doesn't view Atomic Samurai as a rival). He also displayed concern for Bang when he was struck by Melzargard. Both heroes would go out fishing together and have a talk about how despite that they've aged, they're still sharper and stronger as ever. During the raid on the Monster Association, Atomic Samurai happily relieves a beleaguered Bang to allow him to confront Garou, for which Bang is deeply grateful. Iaian. Iaian is Atomic Samurai's best student and junior hero to his master. As a master, Atomic Samurai tries to maintain his image as a role model to his students, wanting Iaian to have faith in him and his abilities. He also looks out for Iaian's well-being. He made sure that Iaian was alright during the Dark Matter Thieves invasion, encouraged him to not give up as a swordsman after losing his arm, and helped him run from the collapsing spaceship. Atomic Samurai also appears to treat Iaian casually, calling him by his nickname, 'Iai'. Iaian holds respect for his master and also looks out for his well-being. He takes pride in being Atomic Samurai's number one student, wanting to make his master proud by going after Garou by himself. Despite his admiration for his master, he gets annoyed at his master's habit of not listening to him. Saitama. Due to his pride for only acknowledging the strong based on current appearance and reputation, Atomic Samurai doesn't treat Saitama with the proper mannerisms or respect, unaware of his enormous strength. Sweet Mask. Despite him being the reason his top disciples aren't in S-Class, Atomic Samurai thinks Sweet Mask is just a pompous blowhard, but acknowledges his strength after seeing him fight Black Sperm. King. Kamikaze holds respect for King. However, he is not above challenging King to test his own strength. At the same time, he wants to know King's fighting style, since he never witnessed King fight any monsters. However, he is also easily swayed by King's bluffing. In the end, he eventually makes a fool out of himself by assuming King's cowardice and lack of power as extreme power that can surpass him by concluding that King can cut an object at the cellular level, despite the fact King cannot even pull the katana out of the sheath to cut a simple apple. Council of Swordmasters. Atomic Samurai holds deep respect for his fellow swordmasters. During his pursuit of Garou, he personally asked for their assistance to take down the Hero Hunter rather than relying on the Hero Association, with all the other members of the Council of Swordmasters accepting his request besides Haragiri, who had fallen and turned into a monster serving the Monster Association. During the battle against the Monster Association, Atomic Samurai was pleased to see his fellow swordsmen come to his support, and expressed great anger when Fuhrer Ugly brutally murdered them. Before passing away, Nichirin handed Atomic Samurai the Sun Blade and entrusted him to find the Moon Blade as the last request. Haragiri. When Haragiri revealed his malicious intentions to the meeting and revealed his true intentions as a monster to his other swordsmasters, he betrayed and threaten them to join him for power. Drunk with power he boasted on how he was stronger than all of them combined. Atomic Samurai saw how far he'd fallen for his pursuit of his swordsmanship and didn't hesitate to kill him.

Kamikaze/Synopsis History. Kamikaze started a dojo before the founding of the Hero Association. However, he only approved a trio of standout disciples to work with him as heroes. Bushidrill, Iaian and Okamaitachi were recruited after an apple cutting test. As Kamikaze has the ability to tell how a person lived their life by cutting with a sword, he only recruits disciples if they pass his test. Plot. Hero Association Saga. Alien Conquerors Arc. Atomic Samurai first greets Bang, Genos, and Saitama enthusiastically as they arrive at the Hero Association meeting, although he notes that he does not know who Saitama is. Bang likewise acknowledges him and Saitama moves to shake his hand, which Atomic Samurai deftly denies, stating that he will acknowledge Saitama only when he has made it up to S-Class on his own. During the meeting, Atomic Samurai wonders if Bang will teach Saitama and Genos martial arts, thinking that they will make decent rivals for his own disciples. Later, after A-City and a would-be opponent Sky King are destroyed by the newly arrived Dark Matter Thieves, Atomic Samurai's disciple Iaian enters a skirmish with Melzargard. After Iaian loses his left arm, Atomic Samurai intervenes by attacking the alien. Realizing the heavy wound of his disciple, he vows to not allow Iaian's swordsmanship to end in this tragic way. Atomic Samurai then engages Melzargard in combat alongside Bang, Metal Bat and Puri-Puri Prisoner. During their fight against Melzargard, Metal Bat exposes its weakness by destroying the vital marble that allows him to regenerate, thereby allowing the four S-Class heroes to successfully counterattack. However during the battle, Atomic Samurai is surprised to see Bang, who was caught off guard during his counterattack, get sent flying across the battlefield by a direct blow received from the monstrous alien. When Bang got up unhurt, Atomic Samurai slashed the monster and Bang destroyed the last marble inside. After the monster was defeated, the spaceship that was above them started to crash down. Atomic Samurai helped Iaian run towards the Hero Association Headquarters. Sweet Mask appears, demanding an explanation on why the city is in ruins. Atomic Samurai explains what happened, but wasn't good enough for Sweet Mask. Human Monster Saga. Super Fight Arc. Kamikaze attends a meeting of the Council of Swordmasters. At the meeting Atomic Samurai asks the council members for help in catching and killing Garou in worries that Bang might fail and die. The council members agree, except Haragiri who mocks Atomic Samurai's plea. Haragiri proceeds to show them the Monster Cells and reveals he had received them from the Monster Association and transforms into a Mysterious Being himself. Haragiri then orders the other to eat the cells or he will kill them, but Atomic Samurai cuts him first, killing him. Afterwards, Kamikaze and his three disciples, Bushidrill, Iaian and Okamaitachi went on a search and destroy mission to find the Monster Association's base. They searched through the mountains, killing any monsters they come across. Monster Association Arc. Kamikaze and his three disciples arrive at the Hero Association. They are put on stand by as preparations for the invasion of the Monster Association unfold. Sweet Mask antagonizes them dismissing Kamikaze as weak much to his anger. The S-Class heroes, Kamikaze, Tatsumaki, Child Emperor, Pig God, Flashy Flash, Superalloy Darkshine, Zombieman, Puri-Puri Prisoner and Sekingar attend a meeting and they reassure Narinki that they will rescue his son. They each receive a transmitter that will show their location to each other. During the meeting, Kamikaze asks how Puri-Puri Prisoner will turn the monsterized prisoners back to human. Kamikaze mentions to Sweet Mask that he's bringing his three disciples to the underground rescue operation. Kamikaze sees King without the King Engine running and believes he is focused. He leaves with various heroes to attack the Monster Association. Kamikaze arrives within the ghost town of Z-City. There he battles the Monster Association's initial monster attack. He kills the now Demon-level monster Rhino Wrestler and cuts down several other monsters. While exploring the Monster Association Headquarters, Kamikaze feels the aftershocks from Saitama's punch on Overgrown Rover. Later, Kamikaze battles and defeats several monsters including Sword Devil Executioner and G5. G5 proclaims to have analyzed Kamikaze's battle style but is quickly defeated and escapes. Kamikaze decides to leave G5 for the surface team to deal with and continues his advance. Kamikaze communicates to the heroes that he discovered another child and goes after the him. Kamikaze encounters Black Sperm. Feeling confident, Kamikaze brags to the monster on his easy victory much to Black Sperm's ire. However; during their battle, he is quickly overpowered by the monster due to its abilities being the perfect counter to the hero's fighting style and collapses on the floor after being attacked by many clones of Black Sperm simultaneously. As a last-ditch attempt, Kamikaze brings the ceiling down on both of them. Kamikaze is later seen defeated and at the mercy of Black Sperm. However, he is saved when Tatsumaki tracks his position using his transponder signal, and she protects him in a psychic bubble. With his last act, Kamikaze performs an Atomic Slash on Black Sperm before floating towards the surface of Z-City. Tatsumaki then pulls him out of the uprooted Monster Association building, but inadvertently releases her psychic bubbles, causing Puri-Puri Prisoner to fall on top of him. When Okamaitachi and Bushidrill are brought up by Tatsumaki, he expresses relief at them being alive, but notices that Iaian isn't with them. He is surprised when he sees Drive Knight and attempts to use Air Slash against the Psykos-Orochi fusion when Genos requests support, but the monster is too high in the sky to reach. He compliments Iaian on a job well done when his disciple is rescued by Pig God and notes the cooperation between Drive Knight, Tatsumaki, and Genos as they attempt to take down the fusion in cooperation with each other. After Sweet Mask and Puri-Puri Prisoner motivate Superalloy Darkshine to stand up and fight again, Kamikaze suggests that all the heroes cooperate in order to take down the fusion, much to their bewilderment. When Bang, Bomb, and Fubuki arrive, Atomic Samurai questions Child Emperor on his reason for not including Bang in the operation. The heroes then devise a plan to take down the monster once and for all. Eventually, the plan is put in motion as Tanktop Master hurls a building towards the fusion containing Kamikaze, Puri-Puri Prisoner, and Superalloy Darkshine. Kamikaze cuts the building and deflects a beam from the fusion. He then uses his Atomic Beeline Slash to slash the monster, getting out of the way to allow Puri-Puri Prisoner and Superalloy Darkshine to follow up. After landing on the ground, Atomic Samurai remembers that Flashy Flash was still under the base and expresses concern for his wellbeing, but Tatsumaki responds that she didn't sense his presence underground. When Child Emperor gets blown away by Homeless Emperor's attack, Atomic Samurai attempts to reach him over comms but receives no response. He and Iaian are subsequently attacked by Evil Natural Water, which he initially mistakenly believes to be a groundwater leak. Despite their best efforts, they are not able to deal with the monster seeing that it seemingly has no weak spots. Atomic Samurai watches as Evil Natural Water nearly takes out Iaian, however Superalloy Darkshine is able to take the blow before it gets to the swordmaster's disciple. He and Iaian watch on as Darkshine is able to take the high-pressure jets of Evil Natural Water and then seemingly take care of the monster in a single blow. Seeing that Evil Natural Water has been taken care of and that Bang is fighting Black Sperm, Atomic Samurai takes the opportunity to join in the fight by using Atomic Slash to turn debris into dust to cushion Genos while Bang takes out the clones using his Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist. Atomic Samurai reintroduces himself once again to his "special blade testing monster", telling Bang to get the two wounded heroes out of there. Having rethought his strategy against Black Sperm, Atomic Samurai slices the Black Sperm clones in an accordion-like fashion instead of chopping them up completely and then beats them with the brunt force of the blunt side of his sword. Original Webcomic. Neo Heroes Saga. Psychic Sisters Arc. Atomic Samurai talks with Bang about Bang's retirement. He is shown thinking about what he will do without Bang, and questions if he should try his luck with King. Neo Heroes Introduction Arc. He is later seen in M-City looking for King for a duel, however, he cannot find him and proceeds to have sushi with his disciples. During the meal, he meets King at the restaurant and provokes him into a fight. After hearing the "King Engine", he and his disciples mistakenly believe King is in battle-ready formation. During this time, King is choked because of fear, which is further misinterpreted by the others as boldness. Fortunately for King, Kamikaze puts his sword down and praises King's boldness not before slicing an apple into pieces. After that, he forces King to go outside and begin to fight. However, during the fight, King begins to bluff nonsense about a non-existent atomic reaction, which confuses him and his disciples. At the end of his speech, King walks away and tells Kamikaze not to perform his attack since it can lead to casualty, something which the heroes don't want to happen. As the result, Kamikaze puts down his sword. Despite that, Kamikaze urges King to cut an apple with his Katana to determine King's life and power. However, King is too nervous, scared, and weak to even pull the sword out of the sheath. As a result, King delays cutting the apple for several minutes and ultimately puts down the sword to walk away in shame. Fortunately. Kamikaze's delusions about King's reputation and power kick in and he incorrectly deduces that King cut the apple at the cellular level, faster than he can even see, stating that the apple "does not even know it has been cut." In the end, Kamikaze praises King's fake power and asks his students to join him in honing their swordsmanship in basic training since he thinks he needs to practice more in order to surpass King. Meanwhile, King walks away in shock and anguish. He later reports to the Hero Association that he and his disciples will go on a hiatus to train.
