A A (エー, "Ē") is a hero for the Neo Heroes and formerly a criminal with an A-Class level bounty placed on him by the Hero Association. He used to work as a hired assassin, but would also kill random people outside of his paid targets. His goal is to kill as many people as he can before he dies. Appearance. 'A' is a relatively average-looking man with messy hair. He wears glasses and a shirt. Personality. 'A' appears to be a calm and kind individual, evidenced by when he showed concern for Solitude after the latter attempted to attack Suiryu but was blown back. However, given his reputation as a killer, this kindness could be a facade. According to him, he doesn't take pleasure in the act of murder, but merely does it as a "game" to see how many people he can successfully kill before dying. His cruel nature disgusts even fellow assassins such as Speed-o'-Sound Sonic, who claimed he is more rotten than the criminal underworld. Plot. Neo Heroes Saga. Neo Heroes Uprising Arc. 'A' is first introduced at the Neo Heroes leader meeting when he asks Solitude if he's okay after the latter gets knocked back by Suiryu. After McCoy introduces him as an A-Class criminal who specializes in monster techniques, Child Emperor states that he's probably only here because the Neo Heroes will protect him from criminal prosecution, to which McCoy responds that reforming criminals will be to their advantage. Later on, 'A' is seen easily defeating a horned monster. Double Hole and Feather recognize him as a wanted criminal and attempt to accost him, but 'A' cryptically threatens them if they get any closer, stating that accidents happen during hero work. Abilities and Powers. 'A' is an effective fighter, earning himself an A-Class bounty and being noted by McCoy to have a fighting style specially suited for monster killing. His Neo Hero suit significantly increases his already impressive power, allowing him to kill a horned monster with relative ease. However when fighting S-Class criminal Speed-o'-Sound Sonic, he and his Neo Hero comrades were completely outclassed. Equipment. Neo Heroes Battle Suit: 'A' wears a Neo Heroes battle suit, which provides him with a variety of functions. Bladed Staff: 'A' wields a staff with two blades perpendicular to the shaft on one side. Remote-detonated bombs: A uses several remote-detonated bombs during battle to defeat his enemy or escape.

A-City A-City (A市 "A Shi") was a very large city on Earth. After being completely destroyed by the Dark Matter Thieves, the area was rebuilt by Metal Knight into an expansive complex with highways leading to the other cities. It now serves as the location of the new Hero Association headquarters and is currently inhabited by Hero Association heroes and staff. Before the Monster Association incident, there were 67 heroes living in this city. It is later opened as a private residential complex for the rich, complete with pools, restaurants, cafes, and even an underground mall. Hero Association HQ Locations. A-City is home to the headquarters of the Hero Association. The headquarter has at least 66 floors. Hero Apartments. Inside the headquarters, there are apartments for heroes in A-Class and S-Class to live in as an option if they wish. All the apartments are within their own section inside. Hero Apartment 104. This is the room Saitama moved into after his apartment was destroyed and being promoted to A-Class. Training Rooms. It's unknown how many training rooms the hero association has at their HQ, but it's closed off areas for heroes to train and spar with each other. Saitama vs. Flashy Flash took place in Training Room #3. Hero Association Prison. This is a high level security prison where the Hero Association keep monsters captured such as Tongue Stretcher, Twin-Headed Tsuchinoko, Beer Bellee, Man-Eating Capybara and the former Monster Association leader Psykos before her escape. Inhabitants. Heroes. Number of Heroes by Class: Plot. Introduction Saga. Saitama Introduction Arc. The monster Vaccine Man attacks the city. Lightning Max and Smile Man are sent to defeat him but are defeated. Later, Saitama shows up and kills Vaccine Man with a single punch. Hero Association Saga. Rumored Monster Arc. The council of the Hero Association calls up the heroes to check the status of their cities. Alien Conquerors Arc. Boros and the Dark Matter Thieves attack A-City. They bombard the city, demolishing 99.8% of it in an instant. The Dark Matter Thieves are defeated by 6 S-Class heroes, Iaian, and Saitama. The Hero Association contracts Metal Knight to clear and rebuild A-City, which he does in a week. He focuses on turning the Hero Association headquarters into a nigh-impregnable citadel and leaves most of the surrounding city a wasteland. Neo Heroes Saga. Psychic Sisters Arc. Having been remade into a fortress by Metal Knight, some of the A-Class and S-Class move there, including Saitama. Since there is still a lot of vacant property within the citadel, some of it is turned into a private residential complex for the rich looking to stay safe, complete with pools, restaurants, cafes, and even an underground mall. It also has the latest anti-earthquake technology installed. Part of the complex is used by the Hero Association as a prison for Mysterious Beings of up to disaster level Demon. Parts of the stronghold are destroyed when Tatsumaki and Fubuki clash in the prison area, releasing all the Demon threat level monster prisoners. These damages are further compounded when Saitama intervenes by jettisoning both himself and Tatsumaki out of the building.

A Hopeless Swimmer's Counterplan A Hopeless Swimmer's Counterplan (カナヅチ対策, "Kanadzuchi taisaku") is an extra chapter included with Volume 15. Summary. While at the beach, Saitama asks Genos if he could swim. Genos explains that Dr. Kuseno has prepared some parts for him to be able to swim and left to prepare them. While relaxing in the ocean, Saitama wonders where Genos is and calls out his name. Suddenly a telescope lift Saitama, revealing Genos as a submarine with Saitama yelling at him to get a hold of himself.

A New Wind Blows A New Wind Blows (吹き込む新風, "Fukikomu Shinpū") is a special chapter of the "One-Punch Man" manga series. Summary. Glasses is a B-Class professional hero who recently joined the Blizzard Group. While on patrol, he was watching Sweet Mask's interview on a giant screen in the city square about his philosophy of being a hero and promoting his new movie. Glasses is then lectured by Eyelashes for looking away, because he may lose sight of their target. Their target was the C-Class criminal Banero, a red hooded serial arsonist, who apparently was worth some points for heroes. Glasses is troubled because on that day there was also a special sale on vegetables, eventually thinking back to a time when he was an office worker, and life was hard, and that one day on the train, he noticed the Hero Association advertisement. Banero is surrounded by the Blizzard Group, who tell him to surrender, and if he does not, they'll attack. Banero mocks the heroes for how they all wear the same black suits. Eyelashes then tells him that it is their team color. While the Blizzard Group fights Banero, who uses Molotov cocktails as a weapon, Glasses thinks of how even in the Hero Association there are factions, and how the Blizzard Group which is pulling the strings behind B-Class is the biggest one, and how he had to join them. After the defeat of Banero, the members of the Blizzard Group are debating how to divide the credit for defeating Banero, and while they think should be equal, Eyelashes claims he does not think Glasses deserves a fair share, for he is incompetent. Later on, the Blizzard Group is shown fighting a mysterious being called Demonic Fan, who is capable of creating strong winds. Claiming they cannot beat it, Fubuki then appears, telling them with confidence that she will take care of the rest, and that they can go home, causing them relief and the desire to get up cheer her on. Glasses then thinks of how he has changed after meeting someone with an unusual ability like Fubuki, who uses supernatural abilities to defeat mysterious beings, which is very uncommon even among heroes, and that her qualities and abilities are way above the average level. Fubuki then proceeds to attack the Demonic Fan with her Hell Storm, but is swiftly defeated, along with the rest of the Blizzard Group. Glasses,was the only one still standing. After thinking he is doomed, he is then blown away along with a part of the wall by Tatsumaki. She then proceeds to ask Glasses if he is a friend of her sister's, from her B-Class group. He replies that he is just her subordinate and Tatsumaki insults him and breaks his spirit. Demonic Fan begins to attack Tatsumaki, but she is capable of blocking. Tatsumaki notices the creatures ability, and comments that, considering her sister's level of power, she can see why she lost. She then proceeds to disassemble the creature and leave, carrying along her sister with her psychic power. Glasses then notes of how much stronger Tatsumaki is than him. Remembering the insult he received earlier, he starts complaining about how he cannot fight without special powers and how "unfair" society is, claiming that even though he trained more than anyone, without special powers, he stands no chance. Saitama then walks to Glasses and tells him that he came because he heard on the news that a mysterious being appeared in the area. Glasses unable to recognize the hero, thinking he is some unknown C-Class, tells him he is too late and that it has been taken care of, to which Saitama replies that it is still moving. Glasses notices it trying to reassemble itself and notes that it can probably only be beaten by destroying it's propeller. Saitama proceeds to take care of the monster, but Glasses tries to stop him by telling him that he stands no chance and that he should run away. While Saitama tells him that he'll be fine because he is strong, Glasses replies saying that he cannot, and that even he himself, who trained so hard, was no match for it, and that there's a limit to what normal people are capable of. Demonic Fan attacks, but is swiftly destroyed by Saitama, who was bothered by the freezing wind. Saitama then tells Glasses that he just hasn't trained enough, and that he should not mope around and just move forward. Glasses, unable to believe that Saitama has become so strong by training, thinks that Saitama is the son of a millionaire that has received some special training, but his theory is shattered when he hears him talking about a special sale he has to go to. Later on, two men from the Blizzard Group are apparently talking about Glasses, and how he quit the group while continuing his work as a professional hero. Thinking he has no chance against them, they think that he will quit being a hero soon while Glasses is seen jogging behind them.

Abandoned Masses The Abandoned Masses (廃界の衆, "Haikai no Shū") is a notorious group of mass murderers whose goal is to cull the population in the world. The group is believed to be a direct competitor to the Ninja Village. History. In the past, the Abandoned Masses was considered to be extremely powerful that the Ninja Village Leader and his subordinates instructed the trainees to avoid them at all cost. Plot. Neo Heroes Saga. Neo Heroes Uprising Arc. Someone infiltrated the Hero Association HQ and sent the letter stating that the Abandoned Masses is waiting in the ruin of the Ninja Village. Flashy Flash is dispatched to deal with them and he believes they are making a name for themselves and trying to control the underworld after the destruction of the Heavenly Ninja Party.

Aburabozu Aburabozu (アブラボウズ, "Aburabōzu"; Viz: Skilfish) the "King of Organ Traders" was a crime lord who specialized in human trafficking. He possessed a massive underground army. He was killed by Flashy Flash. History. Aburabozu would not stop sending assassins after Flashy Flash, and so Flashy Flash tracked him down and killed him. Later, during their battle with Flashy Flash, Gale Wind claimed he and Hellfire Flame were hired by Aburabozu, but Flash revealed he knew they were lying as he had killed the crime lord.

Accel Accel (アクセル, "Akuseru"; Viz: Axel) is the founder and current leader of the Neo Hunters. He works as a hero for the Neo Heroes. Appearance. Accel is a young man with messy black hair and dark eyes. He wears a long-sleeved black shirt below a vest with pockets, armored gauntlets, jeans pants with knee pads and roller blades on his feet. He later upgrades to a Neo Heroes Battle Suit Personality. Accel comes off as a man of integrity who looks after the well being of his subordinates in the Hunters crew with great responsibility. These traits feed into his very untrusting outlook of the current Hero Association, with him stating that they are a vain organization who only care more about their wealth and reputation than humanity's well being. Additionally, his morality makes him suspicious of Ryumon, who he believes only joined the Neo Heroes to get access to weapons for his gang activities. He's also particularly observant, noting how, in spite of the number of resources previously at their disposal, the HA focuses more on catering to the rich and influential. He recognizes how they obsess over keeping up personal appearances, constantly hoard assets, and take their staff for granted while conveniently ignoring some of their shadier or more questionable proclivities are all more prevalent within the HA than actually getting anything done. Despite his condescension of the organization, Accel respects the working staff whom actually put their lives on the line in service to the whole instead of the few who can afford it. In particular, the vigilante holds a great deal of esteem for a few heroes amongst their roster, in particularly Mumen Rider, who Accel admits inspired the Hunters to take up arms against the monsters to begin with. He even goes so far as to say the former's courage in the face of hopeless odds was legendary in his eyes. He'd even given the eponymous hero a specially designed powered exo-mantle to commemorate his heroic nature. Furthermore, Accel is capable of recognizing his own limitations. Accel is sharp enough and forthcoming in the fact that his paragon doesn't have the necessary power to put out against deadlier foes. Plot. Neo Heroes Saga. Neo Heroes Introduction Arc. Accel is approached by Shizuka, a Hero Association scout with the offer to have his vigilante group, The Hunters, join the Hero Association in exchange for monetary and medical support. But Accel, pointing out the latter's inability to properly handle the latest threats and their dwindling regard for the common people, immediately turns down the scout's offer. As the scout is leaving, Accel tells her that the current Hero Association won't exist for long as a new Hero Organization, that he and the rest of the Hunters have already joined, called the Neo Heroes will soon be announced to the public. He also informs her that, along with himself and the rest of the Hunters, many of the Hero Association's current sponsors are planning to join the Neo Heroes as well and that they have already reached out to several S-Class heroes behind closed doors. Neo Heroes Uprising Arc. Accel is later shown at the Neo Heroes leader meeting. While the leaders discuss Sweet Mask's fate prior to the meeting, Accel expresses his pity for the hero-turned-monster's plight. Upon Ryumon's introduction, Accel questions the idea to supply a gangster with weapons, to which Ryumon responds that the souls of his gang have been cleansed. When Explosive Velocity Snail, a Demon-level Mysterious Being, causes havoc on the highway, Accel shows up to dispatch it. He engages in combat with the large snail, hitting it with his poison-tipped axe to lead it towards a blocked-off branch of the highway. Waiting on this branch are Accel's group the Neo Hunters, who kill the snail with their spears. Accel and his team comment on the effectiveness of the weapons and battle suits, stating they surpass expectations. Abilities and Powers. As the leader of the renowned vigilante group the Neo Hunters, who have successfully defeated two Demon-level threats, Accel is a capable individual. Physical Abilities. Enhanced Strength: Accel is shown being able to hold his own against the Demon-level monster Explosive Velocity Snail, albeit for a short period of time and using a Neo Heroes battle suit. Enhanced Speed and Reflexes: Using his skates, Accel can sustain speeds of 390 km/h while locked in combat. Equipment. Skates: Accel wears rocket-powered skates on his feet. They can boost him to incredible speeds. Neo Heroes Battle Suit: Accel wears a Neo Heroes Battle Suit, which provides him with a variety of functions. Axe: Accel wields a poison-tipped axe, capable of injuring a Demon-level monster. Miscellaneous Abilities. Expert Strategist and Tactician: Accel is able to efficiently formulate and execute plans for taking down monsters, as evidenced by his defeat of Explosive Velocity Snail with the help of the Neo Hunters.

Accelerated Development Accelerated Development is the ability to improve one's strength and skills at an extremely fast rate. Overview. The user can grow far stronger through fighting and training, improving their natural abilities at a far more rapid pace than most other individuals. Usage. Saitama. Nearly a year into his training regiment, Saitama noted that as a result of his repetitive routine, his body started adapting to "moving like a hero should", and his power began to explode at a rapid rate. In no time at all, he reached unparalleled levels of strength, speed, and durability through this regiment, a testament to his growth rate. However, according to Genos, Saitama himself cannot explain the secret behind his own strength; the cyborg being certain that he shouldn't have gotten as unbelievably powerful as he currently is by doing such a mundane level of training. Even after reaching an extreme level of power, to the point where nobody was remotely on par with his strength, Saitama continues to grow in power. After experiencing an upsurge of intense emotion, Saitama's rate of growth increase exponentially so that he rapidly outclassed Garou with every subsequent punch, despite Garou's attempts to copy Saitama's level of strength. Garou. Garou's usage of this ability is also at an incredible degree, as he quickly gets stronger after each battle. His usage of this ability is enhanced even further after his transformation into a half-monster, going from having difficulty against Royal Ripper to effortlessly defeating him. During his fight with Orochi, Garou has shown to become stronger and faster the longer he fights, only being subdued when the Monster King decided to quickly knock him unconscious without giving him the chance to evolve further. When fighting Superalloy Darkshine, an extremely powerful S-Class hero known for his remarkable strength and overwhelming durability, Garou initially was unable to even leave a mark on him and had difficulty keeping up with his strength. However, as their fight went on, Darkshine noted that not only was Garou becoming more and more powerful every time he was knocked down, but he also seemed to further improve his fighting skills and techniques in the middle of the fight, allowing him to completely overwhelm the hero. Later on, in a more evolved state, Garou has once again demonstrated his advanced growth rate in his battle against Platinum Sperm, going from exchanging numerous blows with him and seemingly only gaining a slight advantage, to being capable of defeating him in a single attack only moments later. Glasses. Additionally, the B-Class hero, Glasses has demonstrated some degree of a heightened growth rate; although nowhere close to the same level as Saitama or Garou. During his time under the Blizzard Group, Glasses was an unknown and relatively weak B-Class, lacking any notable fighting skills or physical abilities. However, after leaving the group and setting off on his own, Glasses began training extensively; building up enough willpower to restart his entire hero career solo and deciding that he "had no limits". As a result of constantly ripping his entire body apart exercising, his physical strength and speed grew exponentially, allowing him to rise up to B-Class Rank 20 in record time; a feat which the B-Class Rank 2 Hero, Eyelashes, commented was "unbelievable". Despite this improvement however, Glasses noted that he still hadn't caught up to Eyelashes. Eventually, he grew strong enough to stagger and keep up with a weakened and exhausted, but just as formidable Garou; although, once again, Glasses admits that his teammates (A-Class Rank 10, Stinger and B-Class Rank 6, Wild Horn) were more suited to close quarters combat than he was. Puri-Puri Prisoner. While not at the level of people like Garou, Puri-Puri-Prisoner showcases the capability to grow in strength and overall physical prowess at a rate much faster than normal humans can hope to achieve. While at the start of the series, he was defeated with only slight effort at the hands of the Deep Sea King, a Demon-level (albeit a particularly powerful one) Mysterious Being, since his training, he has grown much stronger than he was before. Most notably, he was able to defeat a monster as strong as the Deep Sea King without much effort, and he also later withstood multiple attacks from Dragon-Level monsters, albeit with heavy damage. Speed-o'-Sound Sonic. Speed-o'-Sound Sonic has shown a very baffling level of growth throughout the series since his introduction. At the beginning of the series, Sonic claims himself to be faster than the speed of sound, who is confident in his abilities and believes himself to be at the top of the food chain. However, after his embarrassing first loss to Saitama, Sonic has dedicated himself to constantly improving his speed and strength in an attempt to surpass and one day defeat him. After his retreat from the Deep Sea King, Sonic comes back and is shown to be on par with Genos and even outpaces him and gains the upper hand in their bout. Despite this, he is still shown to be no match to Saitama, being defeated by shock waves from his Serious Side Hops. Sonic has also been shown willing to trade his humanity for an opportunity to surpass Saitama, seeing that he was willing to consume a Monster Cell and become a Mysterious Being. He then appears once more to face Flashy Flash following "That Man" awakening from his coma, being now able to fight and pressure Flashy Flash during their duel, and even forced him to use 2 of his Ultimate Techniques. Even then, Sonic was able to get up with minimal damage taken despite taking an onslaught from Flashy Flash. Pesky Clown. The longer he fights against a more capable opponent than himself, the more Pesky Clown adjusts and evolves in order to match them. Sweet Mask calls such a monster a "Rapid Growing" type.

Acid Manipulation Acid Manipulation is the ability to control and use acidic substances. Overview. This ability allows the user to manipulate or create the element of, allowing the user to melt their opponents' equipment and (in some cases) the opponents themselves. One of the most common forms is stomach acid, which is generated naturally in the bodies of many different types of monsters. Fuhrer Ugly gained the ability to use acid after being caught in Gums' stomach.

Afterimage Creation Afterimage Creation is the ability to leave behind images of oneself. Overview. The user is able to create images of themselves, usually by moving at incredible speeds. This ability is often used in combat to mislead opponents as to the actual location of the user. Sonic, by using his Four Shadows Burial and Ten Shadows Burial techniques, is able to create up to ten images of himself. When pitted against Sonic using the former technique, which generates only four afterimages, Genos was unable to keep track of the ninja's movements at all. Through his Serious Side Hops technique, Saitama can leave behind countless afterimages of himself that makes it impossible for his opponents to tell his actual location. Upon witnessing this attack, Sonic was left utterly flabbergasted and he was quickly overwhelmed. During his battle against Superalloy Darkshine, Garou was shown to create a flurry of afterimages of himself in an attempt to confuse the hero and attack him using a kick. Though Darkshine managed to see through his movements and punch the real one, knocking the Hero Hunter back.

Aggregation Aggregation (シュウゴウタイ, "Shūgōtai") is a Dragon-level Mysterious Being. Appearance. Aggregation is a massive floating cluster of countless numbers of insects. It appears as a vaguely spherical cloud floating in the air, but it only has a shape when the insects it's made of are close to one another. As soon as the swarm attacks, the size of the cloud decreases immediately. Personality. Not much is known from Aggregation personality or even if it was sentient. Plot. Neo Heroes Saga. Neo Heroes Uprising Arc. Tatsumaki is seen engaging Aggregation, suspending it in the air before the mass seems to leap towards her. The monster is later killed by Tatsumaki. Abilities and Powers. As a Dragon-level Mysterious Being, Aggregation was a really dangerous monster but not much was seen from its fighting capabilities since it was easily dispatched by Tatsumaki. Despite that it was still able to cause serious destruction to P City during their confrontation. Flight: As a cluster of flying insects, Aggregation can fly through the air.

Agoni Agoni (アゴーニ, "Agōni") is a multi-millionaire and the founder of the Hero Association. He came up with the idea when his grandson was saved from a Mysterious Being by a passerby 3 years ago. He has yet to make a physical appearance in the story. In the Hero Association, he contributed 70 percent of his riches to the construction of facilities, employment of personnel, and system design. Appearance. Agoni is largely characterized by his enormous cleft chin. He is an older looking man with a wide nose, large mustache, and bushy eyebrows. His hair is straight, brown, and parted on the left. He dresses in a formal business suit. History. Agoni's grandson jokingly vandalized the shell of Crablante, a Mysterious Being, which made him the target of the being's slaughter. He was saved, however, by Saitama, a passerby stranger. Agoni was so moved by this that he created the Hero Association and the National Superhero Registry to create and manage superheroes like Saitama, who would protect humanity against the Mysterious Beings. Plot. Hero Association Saga. National Superhero Registry Arc. Agoni appears in a booklet Saitama was given after successfully registering as a hero.

Air Air (エアー, "Eā"; Viz: Ayer) is the A-Class Rank 35 professional hero for the Hero Association. Appearance. Air is a muscular dark-skinned man with his black hair tied into two ponytails. He wears earrings, a shell necklace, and a grass skirt with no shirt. He decorates his forehead and cheeks with black boomerang markings, along with black dots on his eyebrows. Personality. Air carries himself with confidence and a hint of aggression, evident in his boldness to confront Pig God. He exudes eagerness and a certain belligerent attitude, firmly convinced of the significance of training. Plot. Neo Heroes Saga. Psychic Sisters Arc. Air appears to take a wounded Pig God back to the hospital but is nearly killed by Evil Natural Water. He later appears in the hospital with a mechanical implant in his throat to save his voice after the attack on his life. Appearances in Other Media. Extra Chapters. Disaster Level. Air arrives to fight Black Roast and defeats the Mysterious Being in one hit. Abilities and Powers. Not much is known about his abilities, but being an A-Class hero, Air is a skilled and powerful fighter. Physical Abilities. Enhanced Strength: As an A-Class hero, Air presumably has rather good strength. He is strong enough to throw his boomerang at speeds that can kill Tiger-level threats. Enhanced Speed and Reflexes: As an A-Class hero, Air presumably has good speed and reflexes. Air is able to throw his boomerang at high speeds and react in time to catch it. Fighting Style. Boomerang Skills: Air is quite skilled with a boomerang. He is skilled enough to defeat a Tiger-level threat in one hit. Equipment. Boomerang: Air carries a boomerang on him and is quite skilled in using it.

Air Manipulation Air Manipulation is the ability to control the air and wind according to the user's will. Overview. This ability allows the user to generate gusts of wind, enabling them to even create tornadoes. Through his powerful wings, Phoenix Man could create a powerful tide of wind to sweep away heroes before him, and this is enhanced after his resurrection to the point where he can blow around superheated blasts of air. Flashy Flash is able to use wind with use of one of the Legendary Demon Blades.

Alien Conquerors Arc The Alien Conquerors Arc is the eighth arc of the "One-Punch Man" series, and the fifth arc of the Hero Association Saga. It is also the last arc of the first season of the anime. Plot. Bang is shown demonstrating his technique, Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist, to Saitama and Genos. He asks if they would like to give the technique a try. Unfortunately, they decline Bang's offer. Charanko is angered by their decline and challenges to fight them. Genos quickly defeats Charanko and states that he underwhelmed by the lack of skilled fighters in Bang's dojo. Bang explains that his dojo used to be full of skilled disciples, but they were all disabled by Garou, Bang's best disciple in the past. Bang further tells them that he expelled Garou after giving him a beating. Saitama acknowledges Bang's strength; a statement which Charanko would then scorn Saitama for because of his lack of knowledge of Bang's popularity. After Charanko's constant talk, a Hero Association employee arrives at Bang's front door informing Bang and the others that an emergency summons has been issued to S-Class heroes. Bang, Saitama, and Genos leave for the meeting, while Charanko is left to watch over the dojo. At the headquarters, they are greeted by Atomic Samurai. Atomic Samurai declines Saitama's offer for a handshake, stating that he will greet him when he becomes an S-Class hero. Tatsumaki suddenly starts shouting at Saitama and belittling him only to have Genos inform Saitama that she is rank two in the S-Class and is an esper. At the meeting, each S-Class member gives off their thoughts on the matter. Saitama asks for tea. Sitch enters the meeting room and introduces himself. Before explaining the situation, he warns them that once they start listening to what he has to say, they will be confined to the room until the meeting is over. Metal Bat interrupts Sitch, stating that he had to skip his sister's piano concert to attend this meeting, and threatens to destroy the headquarter building if Sitch did not have anything important to say. Sitch announces that the great prophet, Shibabawa, is dead. Most of the heroes are shocked to hear this news. Zombieman asks whether she was murdered, which Sitch replies that she just died from choking on cough drops. Superalloy Darkshine asserts that the Hero Association brought them to tell them that they must now prevent disasters without Shibabawa's help. Sitch states that Darkshine is wrong and that she has always only predicted a fraction of all disasters. Saitama asks Puri-Puri Prisoner who Shibabawa is. Puri-Puri Prisoner tells Saitama that she was a great prophet that could predict the exact timing of disasters, such as natural disasters and monster attacks. Finally, Sitch states that the real problem was that her final prophecy was a note stating the Earth is in trouble. Child Emperor then tries to make an excuse to leave. However, he is only mocked by Sitch, who states that Child Emperor is nothing more than a child if he does not comprehend the danger of this matter. Additionally, Sitch further states that the disaster is above Dragon and will happen within half a year. Watchdog Man comments that they cannot do much to prevent the disaster. Saitama remarks that the prophecy might come true sooner than expected. Suddenly, the headquarters comes under fire from Skyfolk. Outside the Sky King prepares his attack with his henchmen. However, the Skyfolk are then attacked by an unseen being. A large craft is seen flying over A-City, where it stops and proceeds to destroy the entire city. Sky King is then seen, dead, his body falling apart as a large creature with several heads and wings comments to itself on killing the Sky King, and the destruction caused by the ship. Iaian, an A-Class hero, then crawls out of the rubble and witnesses the state of destruction of A-City, the only thing left standing is the Hero Association's headquarters. He then notices the giant ship above him, but only looks for a second before the large monster appears behind him and attempts to crush his head. He manages to evade the attack as the monster only crushes his helmet, its occupant having moved safely away. Iaian comments on how there would be no way he would not notice the monsters killing intent and then proceeds to attack it. Sitch is screaming, and after seeing that A-City was destroyed in an instant, he is certain the "earth is in danger" prophecy had come true. Bang asks Sitch why the Hero Association building is still standing, to which he is answered with the fact that Metal Knight had built it, and that it is much stronger than an average shelter, Metal Bat then notes that because it is built like a bomb shelter, the place has no windows. The heroes are preparing to leave to deal the threat outside, and just as Genos is about to ask Saitama to join them, he notices that his master is not there and that a hole in the "impenetrable fortress" ceiling has been made, apparently all the way to its roof. Saitama is then seen on the roof, preparing to deal with the threat in front of him, a giant spaceship. Saitama leaps towards the spaceship and is shot with a colossal-size bullet, which he is able to dodge, and is also relieved, due to the fact that if the weapon was a laser beam, it would've burned off his clothes. Saitama is then once more shot with gigantic bullets, but repels them and sends them back to their own ship. Meanwhile, Iaian is still fighting the alien Melzargard, who appears invulnerable to his attacks. The alien then retaliates and demolishes the area behind Iaian, as well as his left arm. The alien then proceeds to split himself, into 5 different forms. The creature then proceeds to split itself into more individuals and proceed to attack Iaian, however, they are stopped by Atomic Samurai who shows concern for Iaian's injuries. The creature regenerates, and Atomic Samurai engages it in a fight. Once it seems that Atomic Samurai has gained the upper hand the individuals combine to form one single entity who seems to be excited at the prospect that someone can match them in power. Bang, Metal Bat and Puri-Puri Prisoner arrive to aid Atomic Samurai to take on Melzargard. S-Class heroes are then seen debating on how to deal with the flying ship, Superalloy Darkshine suggests King takes on the ship to which King replies that he is unable to do so, hearing this angers Tatsumaki who then decides to stop the ship by herself. Saitama is then seen having already boarded the ship in an altercation with Groribas who is easily defeated in one punch before even given the chance to attack. He then decides to destroy the ship from the inside much to the dismay of Geryuganshoop who is shocked by the power Saitama possesses. Boros then appears and is then shocked after learning of Groribas' defeat. As the S-Class heroes battle the monster, Melzargard was struck by Bang and decides to contact the ship to prepare the cannons. He creates a small flying head to contact the ship, but the head was struck by Metal Bat. Geryuganshoop then contacts Melzargard to inform him someone intruded into the ship. Metal Bat, Bang, Puri-Puri Prisoner, and Atomic Samurai continue their battle with Melzargard. Iaian suggests to retreat, but the heroes refuse to listen. Melzargard is then contacted by Geryuganshoop asking him to return to the ship to deal with Saitama but he is preoccupied with the S-Class heroes, Metal Bat then discovers his core which is his weakness and proceeds to smash it, taking out one of the heads. Saitama is exploring the ship when he hears Geryuganshoop voice via telepathy who tries the direct him out of the ship, Saitama follows the opposite of his orders and ends up confronting Boros in his chambers. Geryuganshoop then appears and attempts to fight Saitama using telekinesis. Geryuganshoop enters a fight with Saitama, and hurls a rock at him with his telekinesis. Unaffected, Saitama retaliates by throwing a rock back at him with enough force to split his head in two. Boros who has observed the fight is impressed and explains how he has traveled through the entire universe, because a prophet told him about someone who could give him an enjoyable fight. Saitama then punches Boros in the stomach scolding him about rampaging on other planets. Boros miraculously survives, but his armor that seals his strength is broken, Boros then begins a new transformation. The Dark Matter Gunner focuses the ships cannons in order to support Melzargard against the S-Class heroes, but just when the missiles were about to hit the ground Tatsumaki stops them in mid-air. Tatsumaki stops the missiles saving the S-Class heroes, she then sends them back at the ship damaging it, to the distress of Melzargard. The S-Class heroes then gain the advantage over Melzargard with Bang finding another one of his cores, Melzargard then hits back at Bang. The fight between Saitama and Boros continues, with both individuals acknowledging each other's strength. Tanktop Master then tries to help Tatsumaki by throwing a piece of a building at the ship, but ends up getting caught up in her own psychic attack against the ship. The crew of the ship worries about their fate due to the attack. Genos, Drive Knight and Child Emperor watch as Tatsumaki attacks the ship. Drive Knight decides that he's not needed and leaves, but not before giving a warning to Genos about Metal Knight. Melzargard grows to a larger size, gloating about how he has defeated Bang and threatening the other S-Class heroes. Bang proceeds to get up, looking unhurt and shocking Melzargard, who then is attacked by Atomic Samurai and finally defeated by Bang. Saitama and Boros continue their fight, with Boros appearing to gain an upper hand firing a laser from his chest and then striking Saitama from behind. He seemingly believes that Saitama took damage from his attack and explains about his home planet being almost inhospitable and how they have adapted regenerative powers to survive. Saitama seems to ignore Boros's story and asks if he is done with the fight. Boros gets mad and unleashes his Meteoric Burst and begins attacking Saitama. Due to his powerful kick, Saitama is sent into the moon. Saitama realizes that Boros was taking the fight seriously, so he decides to take the match a little seriously too. Saitama jumps back to the ship from the moon and, due to its powerful impact, the ship takes a heavy damage. Upon seeing Saitama, Boros becomes even more excited and attacks him violently, only for the hero to be unfazed and retaliate against him with a punch that temporarily knocks him back. Saitama immediately follows by using his Consecutive Normal Punches on Boros, tearing him into pieces. After regenerating, Boros releases his powerful trump card, Collapsing Star Roaring Cannon, an extremely powerful blast through him. With the blast about to bring end to humanity, Saitama decides to use his against the threat, the Serious Punch, canceling Boros' final attack and ultimately defeating him. Saitama realizes that Boros is still conscious and acknowledges him as a powerful opponent. However; while slowly dying, Boros can tell that Saitama was lying as throughout the entire fight, he never used his full power against him. Boros dies commenting on Saitama's incredible strength as the hero takes his leave. The spaceship crashes into the earth forcing all of the S-Class heroes to escape and completely leaving A-City in ruins. Sweet Mask appears to demand a reason for A-Class state, when the S-Class heroes explain that they dealt with the situation Sweet Mask explains that they should have done a better job, this leads to an altercation between Metal Bat and Sweet Mask. Suddenly Metal Knight appears, to the surprise of the heroes, when Genos questions his appearance, it is revealed he has appeared with the intention of using the alien technology for weapons that are needed "for the sake of peace". Superalloy Darkshine appears finding alien survivors from the crash, but they are afterwards slaughtered by Sweet Mask, to everyone's surprise. He explains that he killed them as they had no right to live because they are evil and he only executed them on the spot. Saitama appears from the wreckage of the ship surprising both Tatsumaki and Superalloy Darkshine. Genos goes to check on Saitama who explains about his fight with Boros, ignoring Tatsumaki. Tatsumaki who is angered about being ignored starts to verbally abuse Saitama. Genos responds by calling Tatsumaki a "brat", who violently slams him into a debris with telekinesis. As she soon also threatens Saitama, Bang calms Tatsumaki down, saying that she must be more conscious of her rank. The Hero Association HQ was rebuilt as an Iron Fortress. The spaceship was retrieved by Metal Knight and moved elsewhere.

Alien Seer An unnamed extraterrestrial seer who was responsible for giving Boros the prophecy about the worthy opponent he sought. Appearance. The alien seer is an alien with eight eyes of varying sizes and multiple tentacles pertruding out of its mouth area. Plot. Hero Association Saga. Alien Conquerors Arc. Boros mentions the seer's prophecy to Saitama about finding a worthy opponent on Earth before they fight. However, the seer never revealed the identity of the worthy opponent to Boros. Abilities and Powers. Supernatural Abilities. Clairvoyance: The seer prophesied that Boros would find a worthy opponent on a distant planet. However, it never stated the true identity of the opponent.

All Back-Man All Back-Man (オールバックマン, "Ōru Bakkuman"; Viz: Allback-Man) is formerly a C-Class hero for the Hero Association. Appearance. All Back-Man is a young man with light colored hair that is brushed backwards and has sideburns along with a defined jawline. He wears a jacket that has the words 'All-Back-Man' on the back. Personality. All Back-Man has been shown to have a very average personality for a hero. When the evacuation center was attacked by the Deep Sea King, he was the first hero to step forward and tried surrendering on the behalf of everyone else so that their lives could be spared. Despite being frightened to the point where he wet himself, he still seriously contemplated fighting the Sea King in order to buy some time until an A-Class or S-Class hero appeared, showing that he wasn't a coward. After this incident with the Deep Sea King, his confidence was destroyed and he quit being a hero out of shame and a feeling of unworthiness of his title. Plot. Hero Association Saga. Sea Monster Arc. All Back-Man, Sneck, Jet Nice Guy and Bunbun Man worked together against the Deep Sea King in an attempt to protect the civilians, but they were all quickly knocked out. After this incident he quit being a hero. Neo Heroes Saga. Psychic Sisters Arc. All Back-Man is present among the other heroes at the Association HQ when Tongue Stretcher, Beer Bellee and Man-Eating Capybara attempt to escape. Abilities and Powers. As a C-Class hero it is implied that he isn't a very strong fighter, though he stated that he was one of the stronger ones among the C-Class heroes. He is described to be rough like a fighter and calm like a strategist. Physical Abilities. Enhanced Durability: All Back-Man took a blow from the Deep Sea King and survived, albeit left unconscious. Fighting Style. Hand-to-Hand Combatant: All Back-Man seems to prefer hand-to-hand combat, as he held his fists high before facing the Deep Sea King. Hero Rating. All Back-Man's rating determined by the Hero Association.

All Life Eradication Fist All Life Eradication Fist (, "Zen Seimeitai Konzetsu Ken"; Viz: Fist Of Eradicating All Life-Forms) is an immensely powerful fighting style created and used by Garou in his Cosmic Fear Mode. Overview. Having reached an epiphany on how the flow of energy works using the teachings from Bang and gained the immense knowledge bestowed upon him by "God" of the flow of energy and behavior of all forces in the universe, this new style of fighting enables Garou to focus and utilize the different energies of the cosmos itself in conjunction with his internal force channeling to simulate natural universal phenomena through sheer physical ability.

Amahare Amahare (アマハレ, "Amahare") was a swordmaster and a member of the Council of Swordmasters. He was killed by Fuhrer Ugly. Appearance. Amahare was a middle-aged man. He had dark hair braided into cornrows and tied in a high ponytail. He wore a floral pattern haori over his white kimono and accessorizes with many necklaces and earnings. Personality. Amahare was a calm and kind man, offering for his pupils to go after Garou. In the battle against Fuhrer Ugly, he willingly sacrificed himself to save Atomic Samurai and Iaian from the foe's acidic punch. Plot. Human Monster Saga. Super Fight Arc. Amahare attends a meeting of the Council of Swordmasters. At the meeting Atomic Samurai asks the council members for help in catching and killing Garou in worries that Bang might fail and die. The council members agree, except Haragiri who mocks Atomic Samurai's plea. Haragiri proceeds to show them the Monster Cells and reveals he had received them from the Monster Association and transforms into a Mysterious Being himself. He then orders the council members to eat the cells or he will kill them, but Atomic Samurai cuts him first, killing him. Monster Association Arc. Amahare along with Nichirin, Zanbai and Spring Mustachio come to aid Atomic Samurai in his fight against Black Sperm. While Amahare is defending against countless copies of Black Sperm alongside his comrades, Fuhrer Ugly then arrives in his mutated form with Gums' stomach acid covering the former's entire body. He then witnesses the monster brutally kill Zanbai by spitting an acid drop onto his head. When Fuhrer Ugly throws his Full Body Melting Punch at both Atomic Samurai and Nichirin in an attempt to kill them, Amahare sacrifices himself to save Atomic Samurai and Iaian when the latter also tries to save his master, shortly before telling Atomic Samurai to avenge Zanbai, resulting him being gruesomely killed as his entire body is melted to the bone from the acid punch. Abilities and Powers. Being a member of the Council of Swordmasters, Amahare is very powerful and skilled in swordsmanship. Atomic Samurai was also confident enough in Amahare's strength to ask him to assist the hero in pursuing and facing Garou rather than relying on the Hero Association. Alongside the other heroes and the other members of the Council of Swordmasters, he was capable of fending off countless clones of Black Sperm surrounding him during their fight. Physical Abilities. Enhanced Speed and Reflexes: Amahare possessed a decent amount of speed and reflexes. He was capable of drawing his sword and slashing at high speeds and holding his own against many clones of Black Sperm surrounding him. Fighting Style. Master Swordsman: As a member of the Council of Swordmasters, Amahare was a highly skilled swordsman. He was capable of holding his own against many of Black Sperm's clones surrounded him. Equipment. Swords: Amahare carried twin jian swords in battle. He also had a pair of double blades mounted on his footwear.

Ancient King The Ancient King (古代王, "Kodaiō") was the king of the Terror Lizard Clan. He was killed by Tatsumaki. Appearance. The Ancient King was a colossal, loosely humanoid creature that had various animalistic features, such as scales, horns, sharp teeth, claws, and a reptilian tail. Personality. The Ancient King was a ferocious and violent being who wished to take over the surface of the Earth for his race, much like the majority of the other "kings". Plot. Hero Association Saga. Alien Conquerors Arc. The Ancient King awakens after 300,000,000 years of slumber, which he spent waiting for the kings of the other clans to be taken out. He is attacked by Earth's military forces, but the missiles prove ineffective against the Terror Lizard's skin. The Hero Association deploys Tatsumaki who takes care of the Mysterious Being. After a brief conversation, the S-Class hero kills the giant monster by crushing him with a giant rock using her telekinetic powers. Abilities and Powers. Not much was seen of his abilities, due to how quickly Tatsumaki disposed of him, however, it can be assumed that the Ancient King's strength and endurance were tremendous. Since he waited for the other kings and their armies to be eliminated, it can be assumed that he was unsure of a victory against all of them together. Supernatural Abilities. Energy Projection: The Ancient King had the ability to charge very large energy beams from his mouth. Physical Abilities. Immense Strength: The Ancient King easily burst out of a mountain, and judging by his size alone, it's safe to assume that he was capable of causing a lot of damage. Immense Durability: The Ancient King easily was able to withstand military missiles and claimed that it would require something along the lines of a meteor to kill him, implying that he had amazing durability and toughness.

Angel ☆ Style Puri-Puri Prisoner Angel ☆ Style (ぷりぷりプリズナー エンジェル☆スタイル, "Puripuri Purizunā Enjeru ☆ Sutairu") is Puri-Puri Prisoner's fighting style. Overview. Puri-Puri Prisoner increases his body's muscle mass, increasing his already impressive strength to new heights in a process he calls "transforming". This causes all of his clothes to tear. Puri-Puri Prisoner usually relies on his raw strength and skill in close quarters combat, when fighting in this particular style. As opposed to the likes of Superalloy Darkshine and Tanktop Master who use their brute strength to defeat their enemies in a powerful blow such as a punch or tackle, Puri-Puri Prisoner instead often uses his brute strength to defeat his enemies in a flurry or barrage of punches.

Angry Grandpa Angry Grandpa (マジギレ, "Majigare") was a Mysterious Being that appeared in the audiobook, Sonic, Becoming Saitama. He was killed by Speed-o'-Sound Sonic. Appearance. Angry Grandpa used to look like a regular human before transforming into a monster. Personality. Angry Grandpa hated rowdy children. He would attack children for being rude. An example of this hatred is that he said: "I’m gonna teach all the kids around here a lesson in manners! And make sure none of them ever try to do whatever they want again like it’s a game!" History. Pushed over the edge by screaming kids and loud music in public, Angry Grandpa became a monster. Plot. Audiobooks. Sonic, Becoming Saitama. Angry Grandpa fights Mumen Rider, but is eventually taken out by Speed-o'-Sound Sonic, who is disguised as Saitama. Abilities and Powers. Angry Grandpa was able to put up a fight against Mumen Rider but was easily taken out by Speed-o'-Sound Sonic. Physical Abilities. Enhanced Strength: Angry Grandpa was strong enough to punch holes in the ground. Enhanced Durability: Angry Grandpa could withstand bullets from police-grade firearms to no apparent damage. Frustration Accumulation: As Angry Grandpa accumulated frustration, he could unleash bursts of immense power beyond his normal limits. Fighting Style. Hand-to-Hand Combatant: Angry Grandpa fought Mumen Rider in close quarters.

Angry Man Angry Man (アングリーマン, "Angurīman") is the C-Class Rank 255 professional hero for the Hero Association, and one of the Surly Brothers. Appearance. Angry Man highly resembles his brothers, with the only real differences being a different hair style and an angry symbol on his outfit. Appearances in Other Media. Omakes. Disaster Level. He appears with Crying Man and Smile Man to defeat Macho Radish. He and his brothers later received a monster notification and encounter Withered Sprout. Initially thinking the monster is weak, they decide to let Angry Man eliminate it and he uses one of his attacks. However, he gets frozen by the monster who was merely pretending to be weak and defeated all 3 heroes easily. He was later unknowingly saved by Saitama. Abilities and Powers. As a mid-ranked C-Class hero, Angry Man presumably isn't very powerful. However, with the assistance of his two brothers, he was able to defeat a monster of an estimated threat level of Demon, although the heroes themselves claimed that the monster was pretty weak and clearly not Demon-level. Physical Abilities. Enhanced Strength: Being a C-class hero, Angry Man has strength above that of a regular person. Enhanced Speed and Reflexes: Being a C-class hero, Angry Man has speed and reflexes above that of a regular person. Fighting Style. Giant Spinning Top Combatant: Angry Man uses a Giant Spinning Top that he launches towards his opponents. Equipment. Giant Spinning Top: He wields a giant spinning top in battle.
